verses.text: While he was still speaking to the crowds, his mother and his brothers stood outside, wanting to talk to him.
Someone said to him, “Look, your mother and your brothers stand outside, wanting to talk to you.”
But he answered the one who spoke to him, “Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?”
verses.html: But he answered the one who spoke to him, “Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?”

verses.text: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Look, my mother and my brothers!
verses.html: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Look, my mother and my brothers!

verses.text: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.”
verses.html: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower / The Parable of the Sower
verses.text: The same day Jesus departed the house and sat by the sea.
Such large crowds gathered around him that he entered into a boat and sat in it while all the crowd stood on the shore.
He told to them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow.
verses.html: He told to them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow.

verses.text: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
verses.html: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

verses.text: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil. Immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of soil.
verses.html: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil. Immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of soil.

verses.text: But when the sun had risen, they were scorched, and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.html: But when the sun had risen, they were scorched, and because they had no root, they withered away.

verses.text: Other seeds fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them.
verses.html: Other seeds fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them.

verses.text: Still other seeds fell on excellent soil and yielded a crop, a hundred, sixty, or thirty times as much.
verses.html: Still other seeds fell on excellent soil and yielded a crop, a hundred, sixty, or thirty times as much.

verses.text: Anyone who has ears, let them hear.”
verses.html: Anyone who has ears, let them hear.”

verses.text: The disciples came and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
He answered them, “Y’all have been granted to know the mysteries of the Empire of Heaven, but it has not been granted to them.
verses.html: He answered them, “Y’all have been granted to know the mysteries of the Empire of Heaven, but it has not been granted to them.

verses.text: For whoever has will be given more, and will have abundance. But whoever doesn’t have, even what they have will be taken away.
verses.html: For whoever has will be given more, and will have abundance. But whoever doesn’t have, even what they have will be taken away.

verses.text: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
verses.html: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

verses.text: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘Y’all will keep on hearing, but never understand; ‘Y’all will keep on seeing, but never comprehend.
verses.html:
In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says,
‘Y’all will keep on hearing,
but never understand;
‘Y’all will keep on seeing,
but never comprehend.

verses.text: For the heart of this people has grown callous; their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn, and I would heal them.
verses.html:
For the heart of this people has grown callous;
their ears are dull of hearing,
and they have closed their eyes.
Otherwise they might perceive with their eyes,
hear with their ears,
understand with their heart,
and turn,
and I would heal them.

verses.text: “But blessed are y’all’s eyes because they see, and y’all’s ears because they hear.
verses.html: “But blessed are y’all’s eyes because they see, and y’all’s ears because they hear.

verses.text: For truly I tell y’all that many prophets and righteous people desired to see what y’all see, and didn’t see it, and to hear what y’all hear, and didn’t hear it.
verses.html: For truly I tell y’all that many prophets and righteous people desired to see what y’all see, and didn’t see it, and to hear what y’all hear, and didn’t hear it.

verses.text: “Therefore, y’all listen to the parable of the farmer.
verses.html: “Therefore, y’all listen to the parable of the farmer.

verses.text: When anyone hears the word of the empire and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what has been sown in their heart. This is the seed sown by the roadside.
verses.html: When anyone hears the word of the empire and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what has been sown in their heart. This is the seed sown by the roadside.

verses.text: The seed sown on the rocky ground is the person who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy.
verses.html: The seed sown on the rocky ground is the person who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy.

verses.text: However, since that person has no root, they are only temporary. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they fall away.
verses.html: However, since that person has no root, they are only temporary. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they fall away.

verses.text: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, making it unfruitful.
verses.html: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, making it unfruitful.

verses.text: But the seed sown on the excellent ground corresponds to the person who hears the word and understands it. That person bears fruit and produces a hundred, sixty, or thirty times what was sown.”
verses.html: But the seed sown on the excellent ground corresponds to the person who hears the word and understands it. That person bears fruit and produces a hundred, sixty, or thirty times what was sown.”

verses.heading: The Parable of Wheat Versus Weeds / The Parable of Wheat Versus Weeds
verses.text: Jesus presented another parable, saying, “The Empire of Heaven is like a man who sowed excellent seed in his field,
verses.html: Jesus presented another parable, saying, “The Empire of Heaven is like a man who sowed excellent seed in his field,

verses.text: but while the men were sleeping, an enemy came and sowed weeds also among the wheat and then went away.
verses.html: but while the men were sleeping, an enemy came and sowed weeds also among the wheat and then went away.

verses.text: But when the wheat sprang up and produced grain, then the weeds also appeared.
verses.html: But when the wheat sprang up and produced grain, then the weeds also appeared.

verses.text: The servants of the householder came and said, ‘Master, didn’t you sow excellent seed in your field? Where did these weeds come from?’
verses.html: The servants of the householder came and said, ‘Master, didn’t you sow excellent seed in your field? Where did these weeds come from?’

verses.text: “He replied, ‘An enemy man has done this.’ “The servants asked, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
verses.html:
“He replied, ‘An enemy man has done this.’
“The servants asked, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’

verses.text: “But he said, ‘No, because while y’all are gathering up the weeds, y’all could uproot the wheat with them.
verses.html: “But he said, ‘No, because while y’all are gathering up the weeds, y’all could uproot the wheat with them.

verses.text: Y’all are to let both grow together until the harvest. At the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, y’all are to collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to burn them. Then y’all are to gather the wheat for my barn.”’”
verses.html: Y’all are to let both grow together until the harvest. At the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, y’all are to collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to burn them. Then y’all are to gather the wheat for my barn.”’”

verses.heading: The Parables of Small but Powerful Things / The Parables of Small but Powerful Things
verses.text: He presented another parable to them, saying, “The Empire of Heaven is like a mustard seed which a human took and sowed in his field.
verses.html: He presented another parable to them, saying, “The Empire of Heaven is like a mustard seed which a human took and sowed in his field.

verses.text: It is the smallest of all the seeds, but when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”
verses.html: It is the smallest of all the seeds, but when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”

verses.text: Then he told them another parable. “The Empire of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour until all the dough had risen.”
verses.html: Then he told them another parable. “The Empire of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour until all the dough had risen.”

verses.text: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables, and he did not speak to them without a parable.
This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Wheat and Weeds Explained / The Parable of the Wheat and Weeds Explained
verses.text: Then Jesus left the crowd and went into the house. His disciples came to him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds of the field.”
He answered them, “The one who sows the excellent seed is the Son of Humanity.
verses.html: He answered them, “The one who sows the excellent seed is the Son of Humanity.

verses.text: The field is the world, the excellent seeds are the children of the empire. The weeds are the children of the evil one,
verses.html: The field is the world, the excellent seeds are the children of the empire. The weeds are the children of the evil one,

verses.text: and the enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
verses.html: and the enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

verses.text: So just as the weeds are gathered up and burned with fire, so it will be at the end of the age.
verses.html: So just as the weeds are gathered up and burned with fire, so it will be at the end of the age.

verses.text: The Son of Humanity will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his empire everything that causes stumbling and all who lawbreakers.
verses.html: The Son of Humanity will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his empire everything that causes stumbling and all who lawbreakers.

verses.text: They will cast them into the furnace of fire, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.html: They will cast them into the furnace of fire, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.text: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the empire of their Father. Whoever has ears, let them hear.
verses.html: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the empire of their Father. Whoever has ears, let them hear.

verses.heading: The Parables of the Hidden Value / The Parables of the Hidden Value
verses.text: “The Empire of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in a field. A human found it and hid it again. In their joy, that person then goes and sells all they have to buy that field.
verses.html: “The Empire of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in a field. A human found it and hid it again. In their joy, that person then goes and sells all they have to buy that field.

verses.text: “Again, the Empire of Heaven is like a human merchant seeking beautiful pearls,
verses.html: “Again, the Empire of Heaven is like a human merchant seeking beautiful pearls,

verses.text: who having found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that they had to buy it.
verses.html: who having found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that they had to buy it.

verses.heading: The Parable of the Catching / The Parable of the Catching
verses.text: “Once again, the Empire of Heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind.
verses.html: “Once again, the Empire of Heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind.

verses.text: When it was filled, the crew pulled it up on the beach. Then they sat down and gathered the excellent fish into containers, but the rotten they threw away.
verses.html: When it was filled, the crew pulled it up on the beach. Then they sat down and gathered the excellent fish into containers, but the rotten they threw away.

verses.text: So it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous,
verses.html: So it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous,

verses.text: and will cast them into the furnace of fire, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
verses.html: and will cast them into the furnace of fire, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Have y’all understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.html:
Jesus said to them, “Have y’all understood all these things?”
They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

verses.text: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Empire of Heaven is like a human owner of a house, who brings out of their treasure new and old things.”
verses.html: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Empire of Heaven is like a human owner of a house, who brings out of their treasure new and old things.”

verses.heading: A Prophet Without Honor / A Prophet Without Honor
verses.text: When Jesus finished these parables, he departed from there.
Coming into his hometown, he taught them in their synagogue. They were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these miraculous powers?
Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his hometown and in his own house.”
verses.html:
They were offended by him.
But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his hometown and in his own house.”

verses.text: He didn’t do many miracles there because of their unbelief.

verses.heading: John the Baptizer Beheaded / John the Baptizer Beheaded
verses.text: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus,
and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
For when Herod had arrested John, he bound him and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
Although Herod wanted to put him to death, he feared the crowd, because they considered him a prophet.
But on Herod’s birthday, the daughter of Herodias danced before them. She pleased Herod so much
that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.
Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he commanded it to be given,
and he sent the command to behead John in the prison.
His head was brought on a platter and given to the young woman, and then she brought it to her mother.
His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

verses.heading: Jesus Feeds the Five Thousand / Jesus Feeds the Five Thousand
verses.text: When Jesus heard about John, he withdrew from there by boat to a solitary place by himself. Hearing this, the crowds followed him on foot from the cities.
As he got out, he saw a large crowd, and he felt gut-wrenching sympathy for them and healed their sick.

When evening arrived, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is desolate, and the hour is already late. You must send the crowds away so they can go into the villages and buy themselves some food.”
But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. Y’all must give them something to eat.”
verses.html: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. Y’all must give them something to eat.”

verses.text: They told him, “We have here only five loaves and two fish.”
He said, “Y’all bring them here to me.”
verses.html: He said, “Y’all bring them here to me.”

verses.text: He directed the people to sit down on the grass. He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed the food. He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the crowds.
They all ate and were satisfied. The disciples picked up twelve baskets full of leftover broken pieces.
Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Water / Jesus Walks on the Water
verses.text: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he dismissed the crowds.
After he had sent the crowds away, he went up on the mountain by himself to pray. When evening came, he was there alone.
But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, battered by the waves, because the wind was against it.
As the night was ending, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were terrified, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out in fear.
But Jesus immediately said to them,, “Y’all take courage! It is I! Don’t be afraid, y’all.”
verses.html: But Jesus immediately said to them,, “Y’all take courage! It is I! Don’t be afraid, y’all.”

verses.text: Peter answered him, saying, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the water.”
He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the water to come to Jesus.
verses.html:
He said, “Come!”
Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the water to come to Jesus.

verses.text: But when he saw the strong wind, he became frightened, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
Immediately Jesus reached out his hand and took hold of him, saying to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
verses.html: Immediately Jesus reached out his hand and took hold of him, saying to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

verses.text: When they got into the boat, the wind ceased.
Those in the boat worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret.
When the men of that place recognized him, they sent word into all the surrounding region and brought all who were sick to him.
They begged him that they might just touch the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.

verses.heading: What Truly Defiles / What Truly Defiles
verses.text: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,
“Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? They don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
He answered them, “Why do y’all disobey the commandment of God because of y’all’s tradition?
verses.html: He answered them, “Why do y’all disobey the commandment of God because of y’all’s tradition?

verses.text: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘Anyone who speaks evil of their father or mother is to be put to death.’
verses.html: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘Anyone who speaks evil of their father or mother is to be put to death.’

verses.text: But y’all say, ‘Whoever tells their father or mother, “Whatever help I have for you is devoted to God,”
verses.html: But y’all say, ‘Whoever tells their father or mother, “Whatever help I have for you is devoted to God,”

verses.text: they do not need to honor their father or mother.’ By this, y’all have nullified the commandment of God for the sake of your* tradition.
verses.html: they do not need to honor their father or mother.’ By this, y’all have nullified the commandment of God for the sake of your* tradition.

verses.text: Hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about y’all,
verses.html: Hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about y’all,

verses.text: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
verses.html:
‘These people draw near to me with their mouth,
and honor me with their lips;
but their heart is far from me.

verses.text: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine human rules.’”
verses.html:
And they worship me in vain,
teaching as doctrine human rules.’”

verses.text: Then he called the crowd and said to them, “Y’all hear and understand.
verses.html: Then he called the crowd and said to them, “Y’all hear and understand.

verses.text: What enters into the mouth doesn’t defile a human, but what comes out of the mouth, that defiles the human.”
verses.html: What enters into the mouth doesn’t defile a human, but what comes out of the mouth, that defiles the human.”

verses.text: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?”
But he answered, “Every plant my heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted.
verses.html: But he answered, “Every plant my heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted.

verses.text: Y’all are to leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
verses.html: Y’all are to leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

verses.text: Peter said, “Explain the parable to us.”
So Jesus said, “Are y’all still not getting it?
verses.html: So Jesus said, “Are y’all still not getting it?

verses.text: Don’t y’all understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach and then out into the sewer?
verses.html: Don’t y’all understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach and then out into the sewer?

verses.text: But the things that come out of the mouth proceed from the heart, and these are what defile a human.
verses.html: But the things that come out of the mouth proceed from the heart, and these are what defile a human.

verses.text: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
verses.html: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

verses.text: These are the things that defile a human, but eating with unwashed hands doesn’t defile a human.”
verses.html: These are the things that defile a human, but eating with unwashed hands doesn’t defile a human.”

verses.heading: The Canaanite Woman’s Courage / The Canaanite Woman’s Courage
verses.text: Jesus left that place and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
A Canaanite woman came out from that region and cried out, “Have mercy on me, Lord, son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”
But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away, because she keeps crying out after us.”
But he answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
verses.html: But he answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

verses.text: But she came and bowed down before him, saying, “Lord, help me!”
But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
verses.html: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”

verses.text: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”
Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! It will be done for you as you wish.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
verses.html: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! It will be done for you as you wish.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

verses.heading: Jesus Feeds the Four Thousand / Jesus Feeds the Four Thousand
verses.text: Jesus left there and came near to the sea of Galilee. Then he went up on the mountain and sat down.
Large crowds came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others. They laid them at his feet, and he healed them.
The crowd marveled when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled restored, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.

Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have gut-wrenching sympathy for the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away hungry, or they might faint on the way.”
verses.html: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have gut-wrenching sympathy for the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away hungry, or they might faint on the way.”

verses.text: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a crowd?”
Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do y’all have?” They replied, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
verses.html:
Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do y’all have?”
They replied, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

verses.text: He directed the crowd to sit down on the ground.
Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the multitudes.
They all ate and were satisfied. They picked up the leftover broken, seven baskets full.
Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.
Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

verses.heading: The Pharisees Demand a Sign / The Pharisees Demand a Sign
verses.text: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.
But he answered them, “When it is evening, y’all say, ‘It will be fair weather, because the sky is red.’
verses.html: But he answered them, “When it is evening, y’all say, ‘It will be fair weather, because the sky is red.’

verses.text: In the morning, ‘It will be stormy today, because the sky is red and threatening.’ Y’all know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but y’all can’t figure out the signs of the times!
verses.html: In the morning, ‘It will be stormy today, because the sky is red and threatening.’ Y’all know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but y’all can’t figure out the signs of the times!

verses.text: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” Then he left them and departed.
verses.html: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” Then he left them and departed.

verses.heading: The Yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees / The Yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees
verses.text: The disciples came to the other side, but they had forgotten to take bread.
Jesus told them, “Y’all watch out and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
verses.html: Jesus told them, “Y’all watch out and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

verses.text: They discussed this among themselves, saying, “It is because we didn’t bring any bread.”
Aware of this, Jesus, said, “Y’all of little faith! Why are y’all talking about not having bread?
verses.html: Aware of this, Jesus, said, “Y’all of little faith! Why are y’all talking about not having bread?

verses.text: Don’t y’all understand? Don’t y’all remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets y’all picked up?
verses.html: Don’t y’all understand? Don’t y’all remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets y’all picked up?

verses.text: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets y’all picked up?
verses.html: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets y’all picked up?

verses.text: How is it that y’all don’t understand that I wasn’t talking to y’all about bread? But y’all beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
verses.html: How is it that y’all don’t understand that I wasn’t talking to y’all about bread? But y’all beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

verses.text: Then they understood that he was not saying to beware of the yeast in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

verses.heading: Peter Understands Jesus’s Identity / Peter Understands Jesus’s Identity
verses.text: Now when Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, “Who do people say that the Son of Humanity, is?”
verses.html: Now when Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, “Who do people say that the Son of Humanity, is?”

verses.text: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some Elijah, and others Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
He said to them, “But who do y’all say that I am?”
verses.html: He said to them, “But who do y’all say that I am?”

verses.text: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
verses.html: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

verses.text: And I tell you that you are Peter. Upon this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
verses.html: And I tell you that you are Peter. Upon this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

verses.text: I will give to you the keys of the Empire of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you release on earth will be released in heaven.”
verses.html: I will give to you the keys of the Empire of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you release on earth will be released in heaven.”

verses.text: Then he commanded the disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Christ.

verses.heading: Jesus Explains His Coming Death / Jesus Explains His Coming Death
verses.text: From that time, Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and on the third day be raised up.
Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Mercy, Lord! This will never happen to you.”
But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on human concerns.”
verses.html: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on human concerns.”

verses.text: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, they must deny themselves, take up their cross, and follow me.
verses.html: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, they must deny themselves, take up their cross, and follow me.

verses.text: For whoever desires to save their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life for my sake will find it.
verses.html: For whoever desires to save their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life for my sake will find it.

verses.text: For what does it benefit a human if they gain the whole world but forfeit their life? Or what can a human give in exchange for their soul?
verses.html: For what does it benefit a human if they gain the whole world but forfeit their life? Or what can a human give in exchange for their soul?

verses.text: For the Son of Humanity will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to their deeds.
verses.html: For the Son of Humanity will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to their deeds.

verses.text: Truly I tell y’all, there are some standing here who will not taste of death until they see the Son of Humanity coming in his empire.”
verses.html: Truly I tell y’all, there are some standing here who will not taste of death until they see the Son of Humanity coming in his empire.”

verses.heading: The Transfiguration / The Transfiguration
verses.text: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
And suddenly, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
Peter answered Jesus, “Lord, it is beautiful for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
While he was still speaking, a bright cloud suddenly overshadowed them. A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Y’all are to listen to him.”
When the disciples heard this, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
Jesus came and touched them and said, “Y’all get up. And don’t y’all be afraid.”
verses.html: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Y’all get up. And don’t y’all be afraid.”

verses.text: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Y’all must not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Humanity has risen from the dead.”
verses.html: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Y’all must not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Humanity has risen from the dead.”

verses.text: His disciples asked him, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things.
verses.html: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things.

verses.text: But I tell y’all that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted. So also the Son of Humanity will also suffer at their hands.”
verses.html: But I tell y’all that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted. So also the Son of Humanity will also suffer at their hands.”

verses.text: Then the disciples understood that he was speaking to them about John the Baptizer.

verses.heading: Jesus Does What the Disciples Could Not / Jesus Does What the Disciples Could Not
verses.text: When they came to the crowd, a man came to him, knelt before him and said,
“Lord, have mercy on my son, for he has seizures and suffers miserably. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
So I brought him to your disciples, but they could not cure him.”
Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I stay with y’all? How long will I put up with y’all? Bring him here to me.”
verses.html: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I stay with y’all? How long will I put up with y’all? Bring him here to me.”

verses.text: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from at once.
Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

He said to them, “Because y’all have so little faith. For truly I tell y’all, if y’all have faith as small as a grain of mustard seed, y’all can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for y’all.”
verses.html: He said to them, “Because y’all have so little faith. For truly I tell y’all, if y’all have faith as small as a grain of mustard seed, y’all can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for y’all.”

verses.heading: Jesus Explains His Death Again / Jesus Explains His Death Again
verses.text: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Humanity is about to be delivered up into the hands of men.
verses.html: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Humanity is about to be delivered up into the hands of men.

verses.text: They will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were deeply grieved.
verses.html:
They will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.”
They were deeply grieved.

verses.heading: Taxes and Tribute / Taxes and Tribute
verses.text: When they came to Capernaum, those who collected the two-drachma temple tax came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t y’all’s teacher pay the tax?”

He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes? From their children or from strangers?”
verses.html:
He said, “Yes.”
When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes? From their children or from strangers?”

verses.text: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Then the children are exempt.
verses.html:
Peter said to him, “From strangers.”
Jesus said to him, “Then the children are exempt.

verses.text: But so that we don’t offend them, go to the sea and throw out a hook. Take up the first fish that comes up, and when you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
verses.html: But so that we don’t offend them, go to the sea and throw out a hook. Take up the first fish that comes up, and when you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

verses.heading: The Greatest in the Empire Is the Least / The Greatest in the Empire Is the Least
verses.text: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who then is greatest in the Empire of Heaven?”
Jesus called a little child to himself, who he had stand among them.
He said, “Truly I tell y’all, unless y’all turn around and become like little children, y’all will never enter into the Empire of Heaven.
verses.html: He said, “Truly I tell y’all, unless y’all turn around and become like little children, y’all will never enter into the Empire of Heaven.

verses.text: Therefore, whoever humbles themselves like this little child is the greatest in the Empire of Heaven.
verses.html: Therefore, whoever humbles themselves like this little child is the greatest in the Empire of Heaven.

verses.text: And whoever receives one such child in my name receives me.
verses.html: And whoever receives one such child in my name receives me.

verses.text: But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for them to have a huge millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
verses.html: But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for them to have a huge millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

verses.text: “Woe to the world because of its stumbling blocks! Such things must come, but woe to the human through whom the stumbling block comes!
verses.html: “Woe to the world because of its stumbling blocks! Such things must come, but woe to the human through whom the stumbling block comes!

verses.text: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is more beautiful for you to enter life maimed or crippled than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
verses.html: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is more beautiful for you to enter life maimed or crippled than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.

verses.text: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away. It is more beautiful for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be cast into the fire of hell.
verses.html: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away. It is more beautiful for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be cast into the fire of hell.

verses.heading: Jesus Seeks the Wanderers / Jesus Seeks the Wanderers
verses.text: See that y’all don’t despise one of these little ones. For I tell y’all that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
verses.html: See that y’all don’t despise one of these little ones. For I tell y’all that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

verses.text: “What do y’all think? If a human owns one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, won’t they leave the ninety-nine on the mountains and go seek the one that wandered away?
verses.html: “What do y’all think? If a human owns one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, won’t they leave the ninety-nine on the mountains and go seek the one that wandered away?

verses.text: If the owner finds it, truly I tell y’all, they will rejoice over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
verses.html: If the owner finds it, truly I tell y’all, they will rejoice over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

verses.text: In the same way, it is not the will of y’all’s Father in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
verses.html: In the same way, it is not the will of y’all’s Father in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

verses.heading: Relationships, Restoration, and Prayer / Relationships, Restoration, and Prayer
verses.text: “If your sibling sins against you, go, show them their fault between the two of you alone. If they listen to you, you have gained them back.
verses.html: “If your sibling sins against you, go, show them their fault between the two of you alone. If they listen to you, you have gained them back.

verses.text: But if they won’t listen, take one or two more with you, so that ‘by the testimony of two or three witnesses every matter may be established.’
verses.html: But if they won’t listen, take one or two more with you, so that ‘by the testimony of two or three witnesses every matter may be established.’

verses.text: If they refuse to listen, tell it to the church, and if they refuse to listen to the church as well, let them be to you as another ethnic group or a tax collector.
verses.html: If they refuse to listen, tell it to the church, and if they refuse to listen to the church as well, let them be to you as another ethnic group or a tax collector.

verses.text: Truly I tell y’all, whatever y’all bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever y’all release on earth be released in heaven.
verses.html: Truly I tell y’all, whatever y’all bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever y’all release on earth be released in heaven.

verses.text: Again, assuredly I tell y’all, that if two of y’all agree on earth about anything that they may ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
verses.html: Again, assuredly I tell y’all, that if two of y’all agree on earth about anything that they may ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

verses.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
verses.html: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Forgiving King / The Parable of the Forgiving King
verses.text: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how many times should I forgive my sibling who sins against me? Up to seven times?”
Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you, no seven times, but seventy times seven.
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you, no seven times, but seventy times seven.

verses.text: Therefore the Empire of Heaven is like a human king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
verses.html: Therefore the Empire of Heaven is like a human king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

verses.text: When he had begun to settle, a debtor who owed him ten thousand talents was brought to him.
verses.html: When he had begun to settle, a debtor who owed him ten thousand talents was brought to him.

verses.text: But because he couldn’t pay, the master ordered that he, his wife, his children, and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.
verses.html: But because he couldn’t pay, the master ordered that he, his wife, his children, and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.

verses.text: Then the servant fell to the ground and knelt before him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you everything!’
verses.html: Then the servant fell to the ground and knelt before him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you everything!’

verses.text: The servant’s master felt gut-wrenching sympathy, so he forgave him the debt and released him.
verses.html: The servant’s master felt gut-wrenching sympathy, so he forgave him the debt and released him.

verses.text: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii. He grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
verses.html: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii. He grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

verses.text: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
verses.html: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

verses.text: But he refused. Instead he went and threw him into prison until he could pay back the debt.
verses.html: But he refused. Instead he went and threw him into prison until he could pay back the debt.

verses.text: So when his fellow servants saw what happened, they were deeply offended, and went and told their master everything that had happened.
verses.html: So when his fellow servants saw what happened, they were deeply offended, and went and told their master everything that had happened.

verses.text: Then the master called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
verses.html: Then the master called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

verses.text: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you?’
verses.html: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you?’

verses.text: His master was enraged, so he delivered him to the torturers until he could pay all he owed.
verses.html: His master was enraged, so he delivered him to the torturers until he could pay all he owed.

verses.text: My heavenly Father will do the same to y’all, if y’all don’t forgive your* sibling from y’all’s hearts.”
verses.html: My heavenly Father will do the same to y’all, if y’all don’t forgive your* sibling from y’all’s hearts.”

verses.heading: Divorce / Divorce
verses.text: When Jesus finished these things, he left Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.
Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason at all?”
He answered, “Haven’t y’all read that ʜᴇ who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
verses.html: He answered, “Haven’t y’all read that ʜᴇ who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

verses.text: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh?’
verses.html: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh?’

verses.text: So that they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no human tear apart.”
verses.html: So that they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no human tear apart.”

verses.text: They asked him, “Then why did Moses command us to give her a scroll of divorce and send her away?”
Jesus said to them, “Because of the hardness of y’all’s hearts, Moses allowed y’all to divorce your* wives, but was not this way from the beginning.
verses.html: Jesus said to them, “Because of the hardness of y’all’s hearts, Moses allowed y’all to divorce your* wives, but was not this way from the beginning.

verses.text: I tell y’all that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery.”
verses.html: I tell y’all that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery.”

verses.text: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of man with woman, it is better not to marry.”
But he said to them, “Not everyone can receive this saying, but only those to whom it is given.
verses.html: But he said to them, “Not everyone can receive this saying, but only those to whom it is given.

verses.text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by humans, and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the sake of Empire of Heaven. The one who is able to accept this should accept it.”
verses.html: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by humans, and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the sake of Empire of Heaven. The one who is able to accept this should accept it.”

verses.heading: Jesus Welcomes the Little Children / Jesus Welcomes the Little Children
verses.text: Then little children were brought to him so that he would place his hands on them and pray. But the disciples rebuked them.
Then Jesus said, “Y’all must let the little children come to me and do not stop them. For the Empire of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
verses.html: Then Jesus said, “Y’all must let the little children come to me and do not stop them. For the Empire of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

verses.text: When he had placed his hands on them, he departed from there.

verses.heading: The Rich and the Empire of God / The Rich and the Empire of God
verses.text: Then a man came to him and said, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?”
Jesus replied, “Why do you ask me about what is good? There is only one who is good. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
verses.html: Jesus replied, “Why do you ask me about what is good? There is only one who is good. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

verses.text: “Which ones?” he asked. Jesus said, “‘You must not murder. You must not commit adultery. You must not steal. You must not give false testimony.
verses.html:
“Which ones?” he asked.
Jesus said, “‘You must not murder. You must not commit adultery. You must not steal. You must not give false testimony.

verses.text: Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You are to love your neighbor as yourself.’”
verses.html: Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You are to love your neighbor as yourself.’”

verses.text: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed. What do I still lack?”
Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”

verses.text: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he had great wealth.
Jesus said to his disciples, “Truly I tell y’all, it is difficult for a rich person to enter into the Empire of Heaven.
verses.html: Jesus said to his disciples, “Truly I tell y’all, it is difficult for a rich person to enter into the Empire of Heaven.

verses.text: Again I tell y’all, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter into the Empire of God.”
verses.html: Again I tell y’all, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter into the Empire of God.”

verses.text: When the disciples heard it, they were greatly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
Looking at them, Jesus said, “With humans this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
verses.html: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With humans this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

verses.text: Then Peter answered, “We have left everything and followed you! What then will there be for us?”

Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell y’all that, in the regeneration of all things when the Son of Humanity sits on his glorious throne, y’all who have followed me will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.html: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell y’all that, in the regeneration of all things when the Son of Humanity sits on his glorious throne, y’all who have followed me will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.text: Everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands for my name’s sake will receive one hundred times and will inherit eternal life.
verses.html: Everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands for my name’s sake will receive one hundred times and will inherit eternal life.

verses.text: But many who are first will be last, and those who are last, first.
verses.html: But many who are first will be last, and those who are last, first.

verses.heading: The Parable of the Jealous Vineyard Workers / The Parable of the Jealous Vineyard Workers
verses.text: “For the Empire of Heaven is like a human landowner who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
verses.html: “For the Empire of Heaven is like a human landowner who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

verses.text: When he had agreed to pay the laborers a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.html: When he had agreed to pay the laborers a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

verses.text: At about nine in the morning, he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace not working.
verses.html: At about nine in the morning, he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace not working.

verses.text: He told them, ‘Y’all go and work in the vineyard too, and I will pay y’all whatever is right.’
verses.html: He told them, ‘Y’all go and work in the vineyard too, and I will pay y’all whatever is right.’

verses.text: So they went. He went out again around noon and near three in three in the afternoon and did the same thing.
verses.html: So they went. He went out again around noon and near three in three in the afternoon and did the same thing.

verses.text: About five in the afternoon, he went out and found others standing around. He asked them, ‘Why have y’all been standing here all day doing nothing?’
verses.html: About five in the afternoon, he went out and found others standing around. He asked them, ‘Why have y’all been standing here all day doing nothing?’

verses.text: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘Y’all go and work in my vineyard also.’
verses.html:
“They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’
“He said to them, ‘Y’all go and work in my vineyard also.’

verses.text: “When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with the last ones hired to the first.’
verses.html: “When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with the last ones hired to the first.’

verses.text: “When those who were hired at five in the afternoon came, they each received a denarius.
verses.html: “When those who were hired at five in the afternoon came, they each received a denarius.

verses.text: When those hired first came, they expected to receive more. But they each also received a denarius.
verses.html: When those hired first came, they expected to receive more. But they each also received a denarius.

verses.text: When they received it, they began to complain against the landowner,
verses.html: When they received it, they began to complain against the landowner,

verses.text: saying, ‘These who were hired last have worked one hour, and yet you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’
verses.html: saying, ‘These who were hired last have worked one hour, and yet you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

verses.text: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not treating you unfairly. Didn’t you agree with me to work for a denarius?
verses.html: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not treating you unfairly. Didn’t you agree with me to work for a denarius?

verses.text: Take what is yours and go. I want to give to the last one hired just as much as I gave to you.
verses.html: Take what is yours and go. I want to give to the last one hired just as much as I gave to you.

verses.text: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want with what I own? Or is your eye envious, because I am generous?’
verses.html: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want with what I own? Or is your eye envious, because I am generous?’

verses.text: So the last will be first, and the first last.”
verses.html: So the last will be first, and the first last.”

verses.heading: Jesus Predicts His Death and Resurrection / Jesus Predicts His Death and Resurrection
verses.text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside privately, and on the way he said to them,
“Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Humanity will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn him to death,
verses.html: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Humanity will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn him to death,

verses.text: and will hand him over to the ethnic groups to be mocked, flogged, and crucified. And on the third day, he will be raised up.”
verses.html: and will hand him over to the ethnic groups to be mocked, flogged, and crucified. And on the third day, he will be raised up.”

verses.heading: The Mother of James and John Makes a Request / The Mother of James and John Makes a Request
verses.text: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling down and asking him for a favor.
He said to her, “What is it that you want?” She said to him, “Grant that these two sons of mine may sit, one on your right and one on your left, in your empire.”
verses.html:
He said to her, “What is it that you want?”
She said to him, “Grant that these two sons of mine may sit, one on your right and one on your left, in your empire.”

verses.text: But Jesus answered, “Y’all don’t know what you* are asking. Are y’all able to drink the cup that I am about to drink?” They said to him, “We are able.”
verses.html:
But Jesus answered, “Y’all don’t know what you* are asking. Are y’all able to drink the cup that I am about to drink?”
They said to him, “We are able.”

verses.text: He said to them, “Y’all will indeed drink my cup, but to sit on my right or left is not mine to give. Rather, it is for those whom it has been prepared by my Father.”
verses.html: He said to them, “Y’all will indeed drink my cup, but to sit on my right or left is not mine to give. Rather, it is for those whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

verses.text: When the ten heard this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
But Jesus called them and said, “Y’all know that the rulers of the ethnic groups lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.
verses.html: But Jesus called them and said, “Y’all know that the rulers of the ethnic groups lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.

verses.text: It not so among y’all. Instead whoever desires to become great among y’all must be y’all’s deacon,
verses.html: It not so among y’all. Instead whoever desires to become great among y’all must be y’all’s deacon,

verses.text: and whoever desires to be first among y’all will be y’all’s slave;
verses.html: and whoever desires to be first among y’all will be y’all’s slave;

verses.text: just as the Son of Humanity came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
verses.html: just as the Son of Humanity came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

verses.heading: Two Blind Men Restored / Two Blind Men Restored
verses.text: As they went out from Jericho, a large crowd followed him.
Two blind men were sitting by the road, and when they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
The crowd rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
Jesus stopped and called them, and asked, “What do y’all want me to do for you*?”
verses.html: Jesus stopped and called them, and asked, “What do y’all want me to do for you*?”

verses.text: They told him, “Lord, let our eyes be opened.”
Feeling gut-wrenching sympathy, Jesus touched their eyes. Immediately they regained their sight and followed him.

verses.heading: Jesus Received as King in Jerusalem / Jesus Received as King in Jerusalem
verses.text: When they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage, at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,
saying to them, “Go into the village that is ahead of y’all. Immediately y’all will find a donkey tied there, and a colt with her. Y’all untie them and bring them to me.
verses.html: saying to them, “Go into the village that is ahead of y’all. Immediately y’all will find a donkey tied there, and a colt with her. Y’all untie them and bring them to me.

verses.text: If anyone says anything to y’all, y’all say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and he will send them at once.”
verses.html: If anyone says anything to y’all, y’all say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and he will send them at once.”

verses.text: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet,
“Y’all tell the daughter of Zion, See, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”
The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them.
They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their cloaks on them, and he sat on them.
A very large crowd spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
The crowds who went in front of him and those who followed were shouting, “Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord [YHWH]! Hosanna in the highest!”
When he entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
The crowds were saying, “This is the prophet Jesus, from Nazareth in Galilee.”

verses.heading: Cleansing the Temple / Cleansing the Temple
verses.text: Jesus entered the temple area and drove out all those who were buying and selling in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who were selling doves.
He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but y’all are making it into a den of robbers!”
verses.html: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but y’all are making it into a den of robbers!”

verses.text: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were shouting in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant.
They asked him, “Do you hear what these children are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Have y’all not read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have prepared praise for yourself?’”
verses.html:
They asked him, “Do you hear what these children are saying?”
Jesus said to them, “Yes. Have y’all not read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have prepared praise for yourself?’”

verses.text: Then he left them, went out of the city to Bethany, and spent the night there.

verses.heading: Jesus Curses a Fig Tree / Jesus Curses a Fig Tree
verses.text: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.
Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. Then he said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered.
verses.html:
Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. Then he said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!”
Immediately the fig tree withered.

verses.text: When the disciples saw this, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?”

Jesus answered them, “Truly I tell y’all, if you* have faith and don’t doubt, y’all will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if y’all say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and cast into the sea,’ it will be done.
verses.html: Jesus answered them, “Truly I tell y’all, if you* have faith and don’t doubt, y’all will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if y’all say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and cast into the sea,’ it will be done.

verses.text: All things y’all ask for in prayer, believing, y’all will receive.”
verses.html: All things y’all ask for in prayer, believing, y’all will receive.”

verses.heading: Jesus Outwits Questions about His Authority / Jesus Outwits Questions about His Authority
verses.text: When he had entered the temple courts, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him while he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
Jesus answered them, “I also will ask y’all one question, and if y’all answer me, I will tell y’all by what authority I do these things.
verses.html: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask y’all one question, and if y’all answer me, I will tell y’all by what authority I do these things.

verses.text: Where did the baptism of John come from? From heaven or of human origin?” They discussed it among themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Then why didn’t y’all believe him?’
verses.html:
Where did the baptism of John come from? From heaven or of human origin?”
They discussed it among themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Then why didn’t y’all believe him?’

verses.text: But if we say, ‘Of human origin,’ we fear the crowd, for all hold John as a prophet.”
They answered Jesus and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell y’all by what authority I do these things.
verses.html:
They answered Jesus and said, “We don’t know.”
He also said to them, “Neither will I tell y’all by what authority I do these things.

verses.heading: The Parable of the Two Sons / The Parable of the Two Sons
verses.text: But what do y’all think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in the vineyard.’
verses.html: But what do y’all think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in the vineyard.’

verses.text: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but later he changed his mind, and went.
verses.html: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but later he changed his mind, and went.

verses.text: Then he went to the second, and said the same thing. The son answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
verses.html: Then he went to the second, and said the same thing. The son answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

verses.text: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell y’all that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into the Empire of God ahead of y’all.
verses.html:
Which of the two did the will of his father?”
They said to him, “The first.”
Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell y’all that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into the Empire of God ahead of y’all.

verses.text: For John came to y’all in the way of righteousness, and y’all didn’t believe him. But the tax collectors and the prostitutes did believe him. And even after seeing this, y’all didn’t repent and believe him.
verses.html: For John came to y’all in the way of righteousness, and y’all didn’t believe him. But the tax collectors and the prostitutes did believe him. And even after seeing this, y’all didn’t repent and believe him.

verses.heading: The Parable of the Tenants / The Parable of the Tenants
verses.text: “Y’all listen to another parable: There was a human landowner who planted a vineyard. He placed a wall around it, dug a wine press in it, and built a watchtower. Then he leased it out to tenant farmers and went on a journey.
verses.html: “Y’all listen to another parable: There was a human landowner who planted a vineyard. He placed a wall around it, dug a wine press in it, and built a watchtower. Then he leased it out to tenant farmers and went on a journey.

verses.text: When harvest time came near, he sent his servants to the tenants to receive his fruit.
verses.html: When harvest time came near, he sent his servants to the tenants to receive his fruit.

verses.text: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
verses.html: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

verses.text: Again he sent another group of servants larger than the first, and they treated them the same way.
verses.html: Again he sent another group of servants larger than the first, and they treated them the same way.

verses.text: Finally he sent them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.html: Finally he sent them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

verses.text: But the tenants, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and take his inheritance.’
verses.html: But the tenants, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and take his inheritance.’

verses.text: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
verses.html: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.

verses.text: “Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?”
verses.html: “Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?”

verses.text: They told him, “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end, and will lease out the vineyard to other tenants who will give him the proceeds at harvest time.”
Jesus said to them, “Have y’all never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This was from the Lord,
verses.html:
Jesus said to them, “Have y’all never read in the Scriptures,
‘The stone which the builders rejected
has become the cornerstone.
This was from the Lord,

verses.text: “Therefore I tell y’all that the Empire of God will be taken away from y’all and will be given to an ethnic group producing its fruit.
verses.html: “Therefore I tell y’all that the Empire of God will be taken away from y’all and will be given to an ethnic group producing its fruit.

verses.text: The one who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, and the one on whom it falls will be crushed.”
verses.html: The one who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, and the one on whom it falls will be crushed.”

verses.text: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they understood that he was speaking about them.
They were seeking a way to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowd, because they considered him to be a prophet.

verses.heading: The Parable of the Wedding Banquet / The Parable of the Wedding Banquet
verses.text: Again, Jesus spoke them in parables, saying,
“The Empire of Heaven is like a human king, who gave a wedding banquet for his son.
verses.html: “The Empire of Heaven is like a human king, who gave a wedding banquet for his son.

verses.text: He sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding banquet, but they were unwilling to come.
verses.html: He sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding banquet, but they were unwilling to come.

verses.text: Then he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Y’all tell those who are invited, “See, I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and my fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Y’all come to the wedding feast!”’
verses.html: Then he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Y’all tell those who are invited, “See, I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and my fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Y’all come to the wedding feast!”’

verses.text: But they paid no attention and went away, one to their farm, another to his business.
verses.html: But they paid no attention and went away, one to their farm, another to his business.

verses.text: The rest seized his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.
verses.html: The rest seized his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

verses.text: “The king was enraged! He sent his soldiers to destroy those murderers and burn down their city.
verses.html: “The king was enraged! He sent his soldiers to destroy those murderers and burn down their city.

verses.text: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
verses.html: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

verses.text: So y’all go to main streets and invite anyone y’all find to the wedding banquet.’
verses.html: So y’all go to main streets and invite anyone y’all find to the wedding banquet.’

verses.text: Those servants went out into the streets and gathered together as many as they could find, both bad and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
verses.html: Those servants went out into the streets and gathered together as many as they could find, both bad and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.

verses.text: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man who wasn’t dressed in wedding clothing.
verses.html: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man who wasn’t dressed in wedding clothing.

verses.text: He said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here without wedding clothing?’ The man was speechless.
verses.html: He said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here without wedding clothing?’ The man was speechless.

verses.text: Then the king said to the deacons, ‘Y’all bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
verses.html: Then the king said to the deacons, ‘Y’all bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

verses.text: For many are called, but few chosen.”
verses.html: For many are called, but few chosen.”

verses.heading: Giving Proper Tribute / Giving Proper Tribute
verses.text: Then the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might trap Jesus in his words.

They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are truthful and that you teach the way of God in truth. You are not concerned about anyone because you don’t focus on the face of humans.
Tell us then, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
But Jesus, perceiving their evil intentions, said, “Hypocrites! Why are y’all trying to trap me?
verses.html: But Jesus, perceiving their evil intentions, said, “Hypocrites! Why are y’all trying to trap me?

verses.text: Y’all show me the coin used for the tax.” They brought him a denarius.
verses.html:
Y’all show me the coin used for the tax.”
They brought him a denarius.

verses.text: He asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”
verses.html: He asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”

verses.text: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “So then y’all are to give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
verses.html:
They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
Then he said to them, “So then y’all are to give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

verses.text: When they heard this, they marveled. So they left him and went away.

verses.heading: Marriage After Resurrection / Marriage After Resurrection
verses.text: On the same day the Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him to ask a question.
They said, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies without having any children, his brother must marry the wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
Now there were seven brothers among us. The first married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.
The same thing happened to the second, and the third, all the way to the seventh brother.
Last of all, the woman died.
Now then, in the resurrection whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had married her.”
But Jesus answered them, “Y’all are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God.
verses.html: But Jesus answered them, “Y’all are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God.

verses.text: For in the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage, but are like angels of God in heaven.
verses.html: For in the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage, but are like angels of God in heaven.

verses.text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t y’all read what God said to you*,
verses.html: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t y’all read what God said to you*,

verses.text: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?’ Hᴇ is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
verses.html: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?’ Hᴇ is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

verses.text: When the multitudes heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.

verses.heading: The Greatest Commandment / The Greatest Commandment
verses.text: When the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together.
One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with a question:
