“Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?”
Jesus replied to him, “‘You are to love the Lord [YHWH] your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
verses.html: Jesus replied to him, “‘You are to love the Lord [YHWH] your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

verses.text: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.html: This is the first and great commandment.

verses.text: The second is like it, ‘You are to love your neighbor as yourself.’
verses.html: The second is like it, ‘You are to love your neighbor as yourself.’

verses.text: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
verses.html: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

verses.heading: Jesus Explains the Son in the Psalms / Jesus Explains the Son in the Psalms
verses.text: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
“What do y’all think about the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “The son of David.”
verses.html:
“What do y’all think about the Christ? Whose son is he?”
They said to him, “The son of David.”

verses.text: He said to them, “Then how does David, by the Spirit, call him ‘Lord’? He says,
verses.html: He said to them, “Then how does David, by the Spirit, call him ‘Lord’? He says,

verses.text: ‘The Lord [YHWH] said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’
verses.html:
‘The Lord [YHWH] said to my Lord,
“Sit at my right hand,
until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

verses.text: For to everyone who has will be given more, and they will have abundance. But whoever doesn’t have, even that will be taken away from them.

verses.text: Y’all throw the worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

verses.text: “When the Son of Humanity comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
verses.html: “When the Son of Humanity comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

verses.text: All the ethnic groups will be gathered before him, and he will separate them from one another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
verses.html: All the ethnic groups will be gathered before him, and he will separate them from one another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

verses.text: He will set the sheep on his right hand and the goats on the left.
verses.html: He will set the sheep on his right hand and the goats on the left.

verses.text: “Then the King will tell those on his right, ‘Come, y’all who are blessed of my Father, inherit the empire prepared for y’all from the foundation of the world;
verses.html: “Then the King will tell those on his right, ‘Come, y’all who are blessed of my Father, inherit the empire prepared for y’all from the foundation of the world;

verses.text: For I was hungry, and y’all gave me something to eat. I was thirsty, and y’all gave me something to drink. I was a stranger, and y’all invited me in.
verses.html: For I was hungry, and y’all gave me something to eat. I was thirsty, and y’all gave me something to drink. I was a stranger, and y’all invited me in.

verses.html: I was naked, and y’all clothed me. I was sick, and y’all took care of me. I was in prison, and y’all visited me.’

verses.text: “Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?
verses.html: “Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?

verses.text: When did we see you as a stranger and invite you in, or naked and clothe you?
verses.html: When did we see you as a stranger and invite you in, or naked and clothe you?

verses.html: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

verses.text: “The King will answer them, ‘Truly I tell y’all, because y’all did it to one of the least of these siblings and mine, y’all did it to me.’
verses.html: “The King will answer them, ‘Truly I tell y’all, because y’all did it to one of the least of these siblings and mine, y’all did it to me.’

verses.text: Then he will say to those on the left, ‘Depart from me, y’all who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels;

verses.html: I was a stranger, and y’all didn’t invite me in. I was naked, and y’all didn’t clothe me. I was sick and in prison, and y’all didn’t visit me.’

verses.html: “Then they will also answer, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t care for you?’

verses.html: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Truly I tell y’all, whatever y’all didn’t do for one of the least of these, y’all didn’t do for to me.’

verses.text: They will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

verses.heading: The Scheme Against Jesus / The Scheme Against Jesus
verses.text: When Jesus finished all these words, he said to his disciples,
“Y’all know that Passover is coming in two days, and the Son of Humanity will be handed over to be crucified.”
verses.html: “Y’all know that Passover is coming in two days, and the Son of Humanity will be handed over to be crucified.”

verses.text: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people gathered together in the court of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas.
They schemed together to arrest Jesus through deceit and kill him.
They said, “But not during the feast, so that the people don’t riot.”

verses.heading: Jesus Anointed by a Woman / Jesus Anointed by a Woman
verses.text: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the home of Simon the leper,
a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, and she poured it on his head while he was reclining at the table.
But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?
This perfume could have been sold for a high price and the money given to the poor.”
Jesus, aware of this, said to them, “Why are y’all bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful service for me.
verses.html: Jesus, aware of this, said to them, “Why are y’all bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful service for me.

verses.text: For y’all will always have the poor with you*, but y’all won’t always have me.
verses.html: For y’all will always have the poor with you*, but y’all won’t always have me.

verses.text: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
verses.html: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

verses.text: Truly I tell y’all, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”
verses.html: Truly I tell y’all, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

verses.heading: Judas Agrees to the Price of Betrayal / Judas Agrees to the Price of Betrayal
verses.text: Then one of the twelve, named Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
and said, “What are y’all willing to give me if I deliver him to y’all?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.
From then on Judas began looking for an opportunity to betray him.

verses.heading: The Last Supper / The Last Supper
verses.text: Now on the first day of the Festival Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
He said, “Y’all go into the city to a certain man, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is near. I will observe the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”
verses.html: He said, “Y’all go into the city to a certain man, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is near. I will observe the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

verses.text: The disciples did as Jesus had instructed them, and they prepared the Passover.
Now when evening had come, Jesus was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.
As they were eating, he said, “Truly I tell y’all that one of y’all will betray me.”
verses.html: As they were eating, he said, “Truly I tell y’all that one of y’all will betray me.”

verses.text: They were deeply distressed, and each began to ask him, “Surely not me, Lord?”
He answered, “The one who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.
verses.html: He answered, “The one who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

verses.text: The Son of Humanity will go just as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Humanity is betrayed! It would be more excellent for that man if he had not been born.”
verses.html: The Son of Humanity will go just as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Humanity is betrayed! It would be more excellent for that man if he had not been born.”

verses.text: Judas, who would betray him, answered, “Surely not me, Rabbi?” Jesus answered him, “You said it.”
verses.html:
Judas, who would betray him, answered, “Surely not me, Rabbi?”
Jesus answered him, “You said it.”

verses.heading: The Lord’s Supper / The Lord’s Supper
verses.text: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and after he had given thanks, he broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Y’all take and eat. This is my body.”
verses.html: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and after he had given thanks, he broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Y’all take and eat. This is my body.”

verses.text: He took the cup, and after he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, “All of y’all drink it,
verses.html: He took the cup, and after he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, “All of y’all drink it,

verses.text: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.html: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

verses.text: But I tell y’all that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with y’all in my Father’s empire.”
verses.html: But I tell y’all that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with y’all in my Father’s empire.”

verses.text: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.heading: Jesus Predicts The Disciples Will Fall Away / Jesus Predicts The Disciples Will Fall Away
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, “All y’all will fall away because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.html: Then Jesus said to them, “All y’all will fall away because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

verses.text: But after I have been raised, I will go ahead of y’all into Galilee.”
verses.html: But after I have been raised, I will go ahead of y’all into Galilee.”

verses.text: But Peter answered him, “Even if all fall away because of you, I will never fall away.”
Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

verses.text: Peter said to him, “Even if I have to die with you, I will not deny you.” And all the disciples said the same thing.

verses.heading: Gethsemane / Gethsemane
verses.text: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Y’all sit here while I go over there and pray.”
verses.html: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Y’all sit here while I go over there and pray.”

verses.text: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee with him, and became anguished and distressed.
Then he said to them, “My soul is deeply grieved, even to the point of death. Y’all remain here and keep watch with me.”
verses.html: Then he said to them, “My soul is deeply grieved, even to the point of death. Y’all remain here and keep watch with me.”

verses.text: He went a little farther, fell on his face and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me; nevertheless, not what I will, but as you will.”
verses.html: He went a little farther, fell on his face and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me; nevertheless, not what I will, but as you will.”

verses.text: Then he returned to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “So y’all couldn’t keep watch with me for one hour?
verses.html: Then he returned to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “So y’all couldn’t keep watch with me for one hour?

verses.text: Watch and pray so that y’all won’t fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
verses.html: Watch and pray so that y’all won’t fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

verses.text: He went second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”
verses.html: He went second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”

verses.text: He came again and found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.
He left them, went away again, and prayed a third time, saying the same thing once more.
Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are y’all still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is approaching, and the Son of Humanity is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.html: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are y’all still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is approaching, and the Son of Humanity is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.text: Y’all get up, let’s go. See, my betrayer is approaching.”
verses.html: Y’all get up, let’s go. See, my betrayer is approaching.”

verses.heading: Jesus Arrested / Jesus Arrested
verses.text: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, arrived with a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent by the chief priests and elders of the people.
Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss is the one. Y’all arrest him.”
Immediately, Judas went to Jesus and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
Jesus said to him, “Friend, do what you are here for.” Then they came and seized Jesus and arrested him.
verses.html:
Jesus said to him, “Friend, do what you are here for.”
Then they came and seized Jesus and arrested him.

verses.text: One of those with Jesus reached out his hand to draw his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting his ear off.
Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
verses.html: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

verses.text: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would at once send me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.html: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would at once send me more than twelve legions of angels?

verses.text: But then how would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?”
verses.html: But then how would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?”

verses.text: At that moment Jesus said to the crowd, “Have y’all come out with swords and clubs to capture me like a robber? Every day I sat in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.
verses.html: At that moment Jesus said to the crowd, “Have y’all come out with swords and clubs to capture me like a robber? Every day I sat in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

verses.text: But all this has happened to fulfill the writings of the prophets.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.
verses.html:
But all this has happened to fulfill the writings of the prophets.”
Then all the disciples left him and fled.

verses.heading: Jesus Accused Before the Sanhedrin / Jesus Accused Before the Sanhedrin
verses.text: Those who had arrested Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
But Peter followed him from a distance to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered in and sat with the officers, to see the outcome.
Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council were trying to find false testimony against Jesus, so that they could put him to death.
But they did not find any, even though many false witnesses came forward. Finally, two false witnesses came forward
and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’”
The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these are testifying against you?”
But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I charge you under oath by the living God: tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell y’all, from now on y’all will see the Son of Humanity sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of the heaven.”
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell y’all, from now on y’all will see the Son of Humanity sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of the heaven.”

verses.text: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? See, now y’all have heard his blasphemy.
What do y’all think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
Then they spat in his face and struck him with their fists. Others slapped him,
saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

verses.heading: Peter’s Repeated Denials / Peter’s Repeated Denials
verses.text: Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him, saying, “You too were with Jesus, the Galilean!”
But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
When he had gone out onto the porch, another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
After a little while the bystanders came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them; your accent makes it obvious.”
Then he began to curse and swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
Peter remembered the words Jesus had spoken, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
verses.html: Peter remembered the words Jesus had spoken, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

verses.text: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people made plans how to have Jesus put to death.
They bound him, led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

verses.heading: Judas Dies by Suicide / Judas Dies by Suicide
verses.text: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he felt remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
saying, “I have sinned by betraying innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You take care of that yourself.”
So Judas threw the pieces of silver into the sanctuary and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is blood money.”
They decided to buy the Potter’s Field with the money as a burial place for strangers.
Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of the one whose price had been set,
and they used them to buy the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

verses.heading: Pilate Before Jesus / Pilate Before Jesus
verses.text: Now Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said, “You have said so.”
verses.html:
Now Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
Jesus said, “You have said so.”

verses.text: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he gave no answer.
Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many charges they testify against you?”
He gave him no answer, not even one word, so the governor marveled greatly.
Now at the feast the governor’s custom was to release one prisoner to the crowd, whomever they desired.
At that time, they had a notable prisoner named Jesus Barabbas.
So when the people had gathered, Pilate said to them, “Who is it that y’all want me to release for y’all? Jesus Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
For he knew that they had handed him over out of envy.
While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent a message to him: “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”
Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Jesus Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death.
But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do y’all want me to release to y’all?” They said, “Barabbas!”
Pilate said to them, “What then should I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Crucify him!”
But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out even louder, “Crucify him!”

So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but that instead a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. Y’all take care of it.”
All the people answered, “His blood will be on us and on our children!”
Then he released Barabbas to them, but he had Jesus flogged and delivered to be crucified.

verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus / The Soldiers Mock Jesus
verses.text: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison around him.
They stripped him naked and put a scarlet robe on him.
They twisted a crown of thorns and put it on his head. Then they a reed in his right hand and knelt in front of him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
They spat on him, took the reed and, struck him on the head repeatedly.
After they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

verses.heading: The Crucifixion / The Crucifixion
verses.text: As they were coming out, they found a man from Cyrene named Simon, and they forced him to carry his cross.
They came to a place called “Golgotha” (which means, “The place of a skull”).
They gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall, but after tasting it, he would not drink it.
When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes among them by casting lots.
Then they sat down and kept watch over him there.
They put the charge against him over his head which read, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
Two robbers crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.
Those who passed by blasphemed him, shaking their heads
and saying, “You who are going destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
In the same way the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders, also mocked him, saying,
“He saved others, but he can’t save himself. He is the King of Israel! Let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if ʜᴇ delights in him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
The robbers who were crucified with him also insulted him.
Now from noon until three there was darkness over all the land.
About three in the afternoon, Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?” (which means, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”).
verses.html: About three in the afternoon, Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?” (which means, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”).

verses.text: When some of the bystanders heard this, they said, “This man is calling for Elijah.”
Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and offered it to him to drink.
But the rest of them said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and gave up his spirit.
Suddenly, the temple veil was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised.
(After his resurrection, they came out of the tombs, entered the holy city, and appeared to many people.)
When the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus saw the earthquake and the things that were done, they were terrified and said, “Truly this was the Son of God!”
Many women who had followed Jesus from Galilee and cared for his needs were there, watching from a distance.
Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

verses.heading: A Tomb for Jesus / A Tomb for Jesus
verses.text: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who had become a disciple of Jesus, came.
This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’s body. Then Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone in front of the entrance of the tomb and went away.
Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting opposite the tomb.

verses.heading: The Guard at the Tomb / The Guard at the Tomb
verses.text: The next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate
and said, “Sir, we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

So give an order that the tomb be made secure until the third day. Otherwise his disciples may come at night, steal his body, and say to the people, ‘He has risen from the dead.’ And the last deception will be worse than the first.”
Pilate said to them, “Y’all take a guard, and y’all go make the tomb as secure as you can.”
So they went and made the tomb secure by sealing the stone and leaving the guard.

verses.heading: Jesus Is Risen / Jesus Is Risen
verses.text: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
Suddenly, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing as white as snow.
The guards were shaken became like dead men because they were afraid of him.
The angel said the women, “Don’t be afraid y’all, for I know that it is Jesus, who was crucified, that y’all are looking for.
He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Y’all come and see the place where he was lying.
Y’all go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and he is going ahead of y’all into Galilee. There y’all will see him.’ Listen, I have told y’all.”
They left the tomb quickly, with fear and great joy, and ran to tell his disciples.
Suddenly Jesus met them, saying, “Greetings y’all!” They came to him, clasped his feet, and worshiped him.
verses.html:
Suddenly Jesus met them, saying, “Greetings y’all!”
They came to him, clasped his feet, and worshiped him.

verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t y’all be afraid. Y’all go tell my brothers to go to Galilee, and there they will see me.”
verses.html: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t y’all be afraid. Y’all go tell my brothers to go to Galilee, and there they will see me.”

verses.heading: The Elders Bribe the Guards / The Elders Bribe the Guards
verses.text: Now while the women were going, some of the guards went into the city and told the chief priests everything that had happened.
After they had assembled with the elders and strategized together, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
telling them, “Y’all are to say, ‘His disciples came at night and stole him away while we were asleep.’
If the governor hears about this, we will persuade him and keep y’all out of trouble.”
So they took the money and did as they were instructed. This story was spread widely among the Jews and continues until today.

verses.heading: The Great Commission / The Great Commission
verses.text: So the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had designated.
When they saw him, they worshiped him, but some doubted.
Then Jesus came up and said to them, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
verses.html: Then Jesus came up and said to them, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

verses.text: Therefore, y’all are to go and make disciples of all ethnic groups, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.html: Therefore, y’all are to go and make disciples of all ethnic groups, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

verses.text: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded y’all. And surely I am always with y’all, to the end of the age.”
verses.html: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded y’all. And surely I am always with y’all, to the end of the age.”

verses.heading: John the Baptizer Prepares the Way / John the Baptizer Prepares the Way
verses.text: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
As it is written in the prophet Isaiah, “Look, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way”
“the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Y’all prepare the way of the Lord [YHWH]! Y’all make his paths straight!’”
John the Baptizer appeared in the wilderness preaching a baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
People from the whole Judean countryside and everyone in Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, publicly acknowledging their sins.
John wore clothing made from camel hair and a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
And he preached, saying, “After me comes one who is stronger than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
I baptized y’all with water, but he will baptize y’all in the Holy Spirit.”

verses.heading: The Father Validates and the Spirit Leads Jesus / The Father Validates and the Spirit Leads Jesus
verses.text: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
Just as he was coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
A voice came from the heavens, “You are my beloved Son; in you I am well pleased.”
Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
He was there in the wilderness for forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels were serving him.

verses.heading: Jesus Begins Preaching / Jesus Begins Preaching
verses.text: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,
and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and the Empire of God is near! Y’all repent and believe in the gospel.”
verses.html: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and the Empire of God is near! Y’all repent and believe in the gospel.”

verses.text: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
Jesus said to them, “Y’all come follow me, and I will make y’all into fishers of humans.”
verses.html: Jesus said to them, “Y’all come follow me, and I will make y’all into fishers of humans.”

verses.text: Immediately they left their nets and followed him.
Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat mending the nets.
Immediately he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

verses.heading: Jesus Casts Out a Spirit on the Sabbath / Jesus Casts Out a Spirit on the Sabbath
verses.text: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath day came, Jesus entered the synagogue and began to teach.
The people were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as one having authority, not like the scribes.
Just then, there was a man in their synagogue with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
“What do we have to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”
Jesus rebuked him, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
verses.html: Jesus rebuked him, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

verses.text: The unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions, then screamed as he came out of him.
The people were all so amazed that they asked each other, “What is this? A new teaching—one with authority? For he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
Reports about him spread everywhere in the whole region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

verses.heading: Jesus Heals Crowds / Jesus Heals Crowds
verses.text: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the house of Simon and Andrew.
Now Simon’s mother-in-law was laying sick with a fever, and they immediately told him about her.
He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.
When evening came, after sunset, the people began bringing him everyone who was sick and those who were possessed by demons.
The whole city was gathered at the door.
He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. But he didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

verses.heading: Jesus Retreats to Pray / Jesus Retreats to Pray
verses.text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he got up, departed, and went to a deserted place where he prayed.
Simon and those who were with him searched for him.
They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
He said to them, “Let’s go somewhere else—into the nearby towns—so that I can preach there too, because this is why I came.”
verses.html: He said to them, “Let’s go somewhere else—into the nearby towns—so that I can preach there too, because this is why I came.”

verses.text: He went throughout all Galilee preaching in their synagogues and casting out demons.

verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Man with Leprosy / Jesus Heals a Man with Leprosy
verses.text: A leper came to him, begging him, falling on his knees before him, and saying, “If you are willing, you can make me clean.”
Feeling gut-wrenching sympathy, he reached out his hand and touched the man, saying, “I am willing. Be clean.”
verses.html: Feeling gut-wrenching sympathy, he reached out his hand and touched the man, saying, “I am willing. Be clean.”

verses.text: Immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
Immediately Jesus sent him out with a stern warning
“See that you say nothing to anyone, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
verses.html: “See that you say nothing to anyone, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

verses.text: Instead, he went out and began to proclaim it freely, spreading the news. As a result, Jesus could no longer openly enter into a city, but stayed outside in lonely places. Still people came to him from everywhere.

verses.heading: Jesus Heals Sin and Paralysis / Jesus Heals Sin and Paralysis
verses.text: When he returned to Capernaum after several days, people heard that he was home.
So many gathered together that there was no more room, not even by the door, and he spoke the word to them.
Some people came, bringing a paralyzed man to him, carried by four of them.
When they could not get near to him because of the crowd, they removed the roof above him. When they had dug through it, they lowered the mat that the paralyzed man was lying on.
When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
verses.html: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

verses.text: But some of the scribes were sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
“Why does this man speak this way? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this is what they were thinking to themselves, and he said to them, “Why are y’all thinking such things in your* hearts?
verses.html: Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this is what they were thinking to themselves, and he said to them, “Why are y’all thinking such things in your* hearts?

verses.text: Which is easier: to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat and walk?’
verses.html: Which is easier: to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat and walk?’

verses.text: “In order for y’all to know that the Son of Humanity has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man,
verses.html: “In order for y’all to know that the Son of Humanity has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man,

verses.text: “I tell you, get up, take your mat, and go to your house.”
verses.html: “I tell you, get up, take your mat, and go to your house.”

verses.text: Immediately, he got up, picked up the mat, and went out in front of them all. They were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”

verses.heading: Jesus Calls Levi / Jesus Calls Levi
verses.text: He went out again by the seaside. A large crowd came to him, and he taught them.
As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he got up and followed him.
verses.html: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he got up and followed him.

verses.text: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
When the scribes and the Pharisees saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, they said to his disciples, “Why does he eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?”
When Jesus heard this, he said to them, “Those who are healthy don’t need a physician, but those who are sick do. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
verses.html: When Jesus heard this, he said to them, “Those who are healthy don’t need a physician, but those who are sick do. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”

verses.heading: No Fasting When the Groom is Present / No Fasting When the Groom is Present
verses.text: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”
Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.html: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

verses.text: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and on that day they will fast.
verses.html: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and on that day they will fast.

verses.text: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new piece pulls away from the old, and the tear becomes worse.
verses.html: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new piece pulls away from the old, and the tear becomes worse.

verses.text: No one puts new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the skins will be destroyed. Instead, they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”
verses.html: No one puts new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the skins will be destroyed. Instead, they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

verses.heading: Jesus is Lord of the Sabbath / Jesus is Lord of the Sabbath
verses.text: One Sabbath day, he was passing through the grain fields, and his disciples began to pick some ears of grain as they made their way.
The Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”
He said to them, “Haven’t y’all read what David did when he was in need and he and his companions were hungry?
verses.html: He said to them, “Haven’t y’all read what David did when he was in need and he and his companions were hungry?

verses.text: When Abiathar was the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests. And he also gave some to those who were with him.”
verses.html: When Abiathar was the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests. And he also gave some to those who were with him.”

verses.text: Then he said to them, “The Sabbath was made for humans, not humans for the Sabbath.
verses.html: Then he said to them, “The Sabbath was made for humans, not humans for the Sabbath.

verses.text: Therefore the Son of Humanity is lord even of the Sabbath.”
verses.html: Therefore the Son of Humanity is lord even of the Sabbath.”

verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath / Jesus Heals on the Sabbath
verses.text: He entered the synagogue again, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.
They watched him to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
He said to the man with the withered hand, “Stand up.”
verses.html: He said to the man with the withered hand, “Stand up.”

verses.text: Then he said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.
verses.html: Then he said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

verses.text: When he had looked around at them in anger, grieved at the hardness of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
verses.html: When he had looked around at them in anger, grieved at the hardness of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored.

verses.text: The Pharisees left immediately and conspired with the Herodians against him, as to how they might destroy him.

verses.heading: Crowds Follow Jesus / Crowds Follow Jesus
verses.text: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples, and a large crowd followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A large crowd, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
He told his disciples that a little boat should be ready for him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press toward him.
For he had healed so many that those with diseases pressed toward him to touch him.
Whenever the unclean spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

verses.heading: Jesus Appoints the Twelve Apostles / Jesus Appoints the Twelve Apostles
verses.text: He went up into the mountain and called those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
He appointed twelve that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
and to have authority to cast out demons.
He appointed twelve: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),
James the son of Zebedee, and John, the brother of James (he called them Boanerges, which means, “sons of thunder”),
Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James, the son of Alphaeus. Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot,
and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

verses.heading: Everyone Doubts Jesus / Everyone Doubts Jesus
verses.text: Then he came into a house, and a crowd gathered again, so that they could not so much as eat.
When his friends heard this, they went out to restrain him, for they said, “He is insane.”
The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He is possessed by Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”
So he summoned them and began speaking to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.html: So he summoned them and began speaking to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

verses.text: If an empire is divided against itself, that empire cannot stand.
verses.html: If an empire is divided against itself, that empire cannot stand.

verses.text: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
verses.html: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

verses.text: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but his end has come.
verses.html: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but his end has come.

verses.text: But no one can enter into the house of the strong person to plunder unless he first binds the strong person. Then they can plunder the house.
verses.html: But no one can enter into the house of the strong person to plunder unless he first binds the strong person. Then they can plunder the house.

verses.text: “I tell y’all, all sins of the children of humanity will be forgiven, including their blasphemies they utter;
verses.html: “I tell y’all, all sins of the children of humanity will be forgiven, including their blasphemies they utter;

verses.text: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven, but is guilty of an eternal sin.
verses.html: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven, but is guilty of an eternal sin.

verses.text: (because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”)
His mother and his brothers came. Standing outside, they sent for him and calling him.
A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Look, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”
He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
verses.html: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

verses.text: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Here are my mother and my brothers!
verses.html: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Here are my mother and my brothers!

verses.text: For whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother.”
verses.html: For whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother.”

verses.heading: The Parable of Seed and Soil / The Parable of Seed and Soil
verses.text: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A large crowd was gathered around him, so he entered a boat in the sea and sat down while the multitude was on the land by the sea.
He taught them many things in parables, and in his teaching said,
“Listen y’all! A farmer went out to sow.
verses.html: “Listen y’all! A farmer went out to sow.

verses.text: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
verses.html: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

verses.text: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil. Immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
verses.html: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil. Immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

verses.text: But when the sun had risen, it was scorched, and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.html: But when the sun had risen, it was scorched, and because it had no root, it withered away.

verses.text: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
verses.html: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

verses.text: Others fell into the excellent ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”
verses.html: Others fell into the excellent ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

verses.text: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”
verses.html: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”

verses.text: When he was alone, those around him and the twelve asked him about the parables.
He said to them, “The mystery of the Empire of God is given to y’all. But to those who are outside, everything comes in parables,
verses.html: He said to them, “The mystery of the Empire of God is given to y’all. But to those who are outside, everything comes in parables,

verses.text: so that ‘seeing they may see but not perceive, and hearing they may hear but not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”
verses.html: so that ‘seeing they may see but not perceive, and hearing they may hear but not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

verses.text: He said to them, “Don’t y’all understand this parable? How will y’all understand any parables?
verses.html: He said to them, “Don’t y’all understand this parable? How will y’all understand any parables?

verses.text: The farmer sows the word.
verses.html: The farmer sows the word.

verses.text: The seeds by the road are like people where the word is sown, but when they heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
verses.html: The seeds by the road are like people where the word is sown, but when they heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

verses.text: Next are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy,
verses.html: Next are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy,

verses.text: But they have no root in themselves, and are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, they immediately fall away.
verses.html: But they have no root in themselves, and are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, they immediately fall away.

verses.text: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. They have heard the word,
verses.html: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. They have heard the word,

verses.text: but the anxieties of this age, the deceitfulness of riches, and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
verses.html: but the anxieties of this age, the deceitfulness of riches, and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

verses.text: But these are the ones sown on excellent ground: those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
verses.html: But these are the ones sown on excellent ground: those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Lamp / The Parable of the Lamp
verses.text: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Shouldn’t it be put on a stand?
verses.html: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Shouldn’t it be put on a stand?

verses.text: For nothing is hidden except to be revealed, and nothing was concealed except to become manifest.
verses.html: For nothing is hidden except to be revealed, and nothing was concealed except to become manifest.

verses.text: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”
verses.html: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”

verses.text: He said to them, “Y’all must discern what y’all are hearing. By whatever measure y’all measure, it will be measured to y’all; and more to y’all.
verses.html: He said to them, “Y’all must discern what y’all are hearing. By whatever measure y’all measure, it will be measured to y’all; and more to y’all.

verses.text: For whoever has will be given more, and whoever doesn’t have, even what they have will be taken away from them.”
verses.html: For whoever has will be given more, and whoever doesn’t have, even what they have will be taken away from them.”

verses.heading: The Empire of God is Like a Growing Seed / The Empire of God is Like a Growing Seed
verses.text: He said, “The Empire of God is like a human who scatters seed on the ground,
verses.html: He said, “The Empire of God is like a human who scatters seed on the ground,

verses.text: then sleeps and gets up night and day, and the seed springs up and grows, though the sower doesn’t know how.
verses.html: then sleeps and gets up night and day, and the seed springs up and grows, though the sower doesn’t know how.

verses.text: For the soil bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
verses.html: For the soil bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

verses.text: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately the sower sends in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
verses.html: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately the sower sends in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

verses.heading: The Empire of God is Like a Mustard Seed / The Empire of God is Like a Mustard Seed
verses.text: He said, “What can we compare to the Empire of God? What parable should we use to illustrate it?
verses.html: He said, “What can we compare to the Empire of God? What parable should we use to illustrate it?

verses.text: It is like a mustard seed sown in the ground, and even though it is smaller than all the seeds in the ground,
verses.html: It is like a mustard seed sown in the ground, and even though it is smaller than all the seeds in the ground,

verses.text: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the garden plans, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can dwell under its shade.”
verses.html: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the garden plans, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can dwell under its shade.”

verses.text: With many parables like these he spoke the word to them, as much as they were able to hear it.
He didn’t speak to them without a parable; but privately he explained everything to his own disciples.

verses.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm / Jesus Calms the Storm
verses.text: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
verses.html: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

verses.text: Leaving the crowd, they took him with them, just as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
A massive windstorm arose, and the waves were breaking over the boat so much that the boat was already filling up.
Jesus himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion. They woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
He awoke, rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Be quiet! Be still!” Then the wind ceased, and there was massive calm.
verses.html: He awoke, rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Be quiet! Be still!” Then the wind ceased, and there was massive calm.

verses.text: He said to them, “Why are y’all so afraid? How do y’all still have no faith?”
verses.html: He said to them, “Why are y’all so afraid? How do y’all still have no faith?”

verses.text: They were massively afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

verses.heading: Jesus Removes a Legion of Demons / Jesus Removes a Legion of Demons
verses.text: They came to the other side of the sea, into the region of the Gadarenes.
When he got out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit came out of the tombs to meet him.
He lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him anymore, not even with chains.
For he had often been bound with shackles and chains, but he tore apart the chains and broke the shackles into pieces. No one had the strength to restrain him.
Constantly, night and day, he was screaming among the tombs and in the mountains, cutting himself with stones.
When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and fell on his keens before him,
and screaming with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I implore you by God, don’t torment me!”
For he said to him, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”
verses.html: For he said to him, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”

verses.text: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
verses.html:
Jesus asked him, “What is your name?”
He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

verses.text: He begged him repeatedly not to send them away out of the region.
Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
They begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, so that we may enter into them.”
Jesus gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs. Then the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they drowned in the sea.
Those tending the pigs ran away, and reported it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what had happened.
They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, the very one who had the “legion.” They were terrified.
Those who had seen it described to them what happened to the demon-possessed man, and about the pigs.
Then they began to beg him to depart from their region.
As he was entering the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to be with him.
Jesus didn’t let him go. Instead he said, “Go to your home and to your people, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”
verses.html: Jesus didn’t let him go. Instead he said, “Go to your home and to your people, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

verses.text: So he went and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Woman on the Way to Resurrect a Girl / Jesus Heals a Woman on the Way to Resurrect a Girl
verses.text: When Jesus had crossed back over by boat to the other side, a great crowd gathered around him while he was by the seashore.
Then one of the rulers of the synagogue, named Jairus, came, and seeing Jesus, he fell at his feet
and begged him profusely, saying, “My little girl is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, so that she may be healed and live.”
He went with him, and a large crowd followed him, pressing in on him.
A woman was there who had a discharge of blood for twelve years.
She had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, yet had not gotten better, only worse.
When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.
For she was saying, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be saved from this.”
Immediately the flow of her blood dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
Jesus immediately perceived in himself that power from him had gone out. He turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
verses.html: Jesus immediately perceived in himself that power from him had gone out. He turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

verses.text: His disciples said to him, “You see the crowd pressing against you, and yet you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
He kept looking around to see the one who had done it.
But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before him, and told him the whole truth.
He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be healed of your affliction.”
verses.html: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be healed of your affliction.”

verses.text: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the teacher anymore?”
But Jesus, overhearing what was said, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid. Just believe.”
verses.html: But Jesus, overhearing what was said, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid. Just believe.”

verses.text: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
He came to the synagogue ruler’s house and saw a commotion, with weeping and loud wailing.
He went in and said to them, “Why are y’all making a commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
verses.html: He went in and said to them, “Why are y’all making a commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

verses.text: They ridiculed him. But he cast them all out, took the child’s father and mother and those who were with him, and went in where the child was.
Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha koum!” which translated means, “Little girl, I tell you, get up!”
verses.html: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha koum!” which translated means, “Little girl, I tell you, get up!”

verses.text: Immediately the girl rose up and began walking around, for she was twelve years old. And immediately, they were massively astonished.
He gave them strict orders that no one should know about this. And he said to give her something to eat.

verses.heading: A Prophet’s Unfortunate Homecoming / A Prophet’s Unfortunate Homecoming
verses.text: He left that place and went to his hometown, and his disciples followed him.

When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to him? What kind of power comes through his hands?
Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended by him.
Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor. Except in his hometown, among his own relatives and in his own home.”
verses.html: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor. Except in his hometown, among his own relatives and in his own home.”

verses.text: He could do no mighty work there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.
He marveled because of their unbelief. Then he went around the villages teaching.

verses.heading: Jesus Gives the Twelve Authority and Mission / Jesus Gives the Twelve Authority and Mission
verses.text: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two, and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
He instructed them that they should take nothing for their journey except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, and no money in their belts.
“Wear sandals, but don’t y’all put on two tunics.”
verses.html: “Wear sandals, but don’t y’all put on two tunics.”

verses.text: He said to them, “Wherever y’all enter a house, y’all should stay there until y’all leave the area.
verses.html: He said to them, “Wherever y’all enter a house, y’all should stay there until y’all leave the area.

verses.text: If a place doesn’t welcome y’all or listen to y’all, as y’all leave that place, shake off the dust off y’all’s feet as a testimony against them.”
verses.html: If a place doesn’t welcome y’all or listen to y’all, as y’all leave that place, shake off the dust off y’all’s feet as a testimony against them.”

verses.text: They went out and preached that people should repent.
They cast out many demons and anointed many who were sick with oil and healed them.

verses.heading: John the Baptizer Beheaded / John the Baptizer Beheaded
verses.text: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and that is why these powers are at work in him.”
But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet or like one of the prophets.”
But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
For Herod himself had sent for John to be arrested and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, because he had married her.
For John had been saying to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
So Herodias set herself against John and wanted to kill him. But she wasn’t able to,
because Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he was perplexed, yet he enjoyed listening to him.
Then an opportune day came. On his birthday Herod gave a banquet for his nobles, military commanders, and the leaders of Galilee.
When the daughter of Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the girl, “Ask me whatever you desire, and I will give it to you.”
He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my empire.”
She went out and said to her mother, “What should I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
Immediately she came in a hurry to the king and requested, “I want you to give me the head of John the Baptizer on a platter right now.”
The king became very sorrowful, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he didn’t want to refuse her.
Immediately the king sent an executioner and commanded to bring John’s head. He went and beheaded him in the prison,
and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl. Then the girl gave it to her mother.
When his disciples heard about this, they came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.

verses.heading: Jesus Feeds the Five Thousand / Jesus Feeds the Five Thousand
verses.text: The apostles gathered together with Jesus, and they told him all they had done and taught.
He said to them, “Y’all come with me to a secluded place and rest for a while.” For there were many people coming and going, and they had not had an opportunity to eat.
verses.html: He said to them, “Y’all come with me to a secluded place and rest for a while.” For there were many people coming and going, and they had not had an opportunity to eat.

verses.text: They went away in the boat to a secluded place by themselves.
But many saw them leaving and recognized them, so they ran together on foot from all the cities, and they arrived ahead of them.
When Jesus came ashore and saw the large crowd, he felt gut-wrenching sympathy for them because they were like sheep without a shepherd. He began to teach them many things.
When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This is a remote place, and it is late in the day.
You must send them away, so that they can go into the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”
But he answered them, “Y’all give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Should we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”
verses.html:
But he answered them, “Y’all give them something to eat.”
They asked him, “Should we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

verses.text: He said to them, “How many loaves do y’all have? Go look!” When they found out, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
verses.html:
He said to them, “How many loaves do y’all have? Go look!”
When they found out, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

verses.text: He directed them to have everyone sit down in groups on the green grass.
They sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
He took the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to the disciples to distribute them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
They all ate and were satisfied.
They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and of fish.
There were five thousand men who ate the loaves.

verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Water / Jesus Walks on the Water
verses.text: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he sent the crowd away.
After leaving them, he went up the mountain to pray.
When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
He saw them straining at the oars, because the wind was against them. About the fourth watch of the night, he came to them, walking on the sea. He intended to pass by them,
but when they saw him walking on the sea, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,
because they all saw him and were terrified. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Y’all take courage! I am! Don’t y’all be afraid.”
verses.html: because they all saw him and were terrified. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Y’all take courage! I am! Don’t y’all be afraid.”

verses.text: He got into the boat with them, and the wind ceased. They were completely astonished,
because they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.
When they got out of the boat, people immediately recognized him.
They ran throughout that whole region, and began to bring the sick on their mats to wherever they heard he was.
Wherever he went—into villages, cities, or the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his cloak. And all who touched him were healed.

verses.heading: Defiled on the Inside or Outside / Defiled on the Inside or Outside
verses.text: Then Pharisees and some of the scribes who came from Jerusalem gathered around him.
And they saw some of his disciples eating bread with impure hands, that is, unwashed.
(For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
When they come from the marketplace, they don’t eat unless they bathe, and there are many other things which they have received and hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, and bronze pots.)
The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with impure hands?”
He answered them, “Rightly did Isaiah prophesy about y’all hypocrites. As it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.html:
He answered them, “Rightly did Isaiah prophesy about y’all hypocrites. As it is written,
‘This people honors me with their lips,
but their heart is far from me.

verses.text: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the human commandments.’
verses.html:
They worship me in vain,
teaching as doctrines the human commandments.’

verses.text: “Having neglected the commandment of God, y’all are holding tightly to human tradition.”
verses.html: “Having neglected the commandment of God, y’all are holding tightly to human tradition.”

verses.text: He also said to them, “Y’all have an excellent way of rejecting the commandment of God so that y’all can keep y’all’s tradition.
verses.html: He also said to them, “Y’all have an excellent way of rejecting the commandment of God so that y’all can keep y’all’s tradition.

verses.text: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘Anyone who speaks evil of father or mother must be put to death.’
verses.html: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘Anyone who speaks evil of father or mother must be put to death.’

verses.text: But y’all say, if a human tells their father or his mother, ‘Whatever assistance you might have received from me is Corban,’” (that is, given to God),
verses.html: But y’all say, if a human tells their father or his mother, ‘Whatever assistance you might have received from me is Corban,’” (that is, given to God),

verses.text: “then y’all no longer allow them to do anything for their father or mother.
verses.html: “then y’all no longer allow them to do anything for their father or mother.

verses.text: This invalidates the word of God by y’all’s tradition which y’all have handed down. And y’all do many things like this.”
verses.html: This invalidates the word of God by y’all’s tradition which y’all have handed down. And y’all do many things like this.”

verses.text: Again he called the crowd and said to them, “All y’all listen to me and understand.
verses.html: Again he called the crowd and said to them, “All y’all listen to me and understand.

verses.text: Nothing outside a human can defile them by going inside them. Instead, it is the things that proceed out of a human that defile a human.
verses.html: Nothing outside a human can defile them by going inside them. Instead, it is the things that proceed out of a human that defile a human.

verses.text: When he had entered the house away from the crowd, his disciples asked him about the parable.
He said to them, “Are y’all also foolish? Don’t y’all understand that whatever goes into a human from outside can’t defile them,
verses.html: He said to them, “Are y’all also foolish? Don’t y’all understand that whatever goes into a human from outside can’t defile them,

verses.text: because it doesn’t go into their heart, but into their stomach, then out of the body?” (Thus, all foods are clean.)
verses.html: because it doesn’t go into their heart, but into their stomach, then out of the body?” (Thus, all foods are clean.)

verses.text: He said, “What proceeds out of a human, that defiles the human.
verses.html: He said, “What proceeds out of a human, that defiles the human.

verses.text: For it is from within, out of the human heart, that evil thoughts proceed—sexual sins, murders, thefts,
verses.html: For it is from within, out of the human heart, that evil thoughts proceed—sexual sins, murders, thefts,

verses.text: adultery, greed, evil, deceit, sensuality, envious eyes, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
verses.html: adultery, greed, evil, deceit, sensuality, envious eyes, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

verses.text: All these evils come from within and defile a human.”
verses.html: All these evils come from within and defile a human.”

verses.heading: The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith and Courage / The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith and Courage
verses.text: Jesus arose and went away into the region of Tyre. He entered a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
But immediately, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit heard about him, and came and fell down at his feet.
Now the woman was a Greek, of Syrophoenician background. She begged him to cast the demon out of her daughter.
But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be satisfied first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
verses.html: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be satisfied first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

verses.text: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
He said to her, “Because of this answer, you may go. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
verses.html: He said to her, “Because of this answer, you may go. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

verses.text: She went away to her house, and found the child lying on the bed, with the demon having gone out.

verses.heading: Healing a Deaf and Mute Man / Healing a Deaf and Mute Man
verses.text: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of Decapolis.
They brought to him a man who was deaf and spoke with difficulty, and they begged him to lay his hand on him.
Jesus took him aside from the crowd privately and put his fingers into his ears. Then he spat and touched the man’s tongue.
Looking up to heaven with a deep sigh, he said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
verses.html: Looking up to heaven with a deep sigh, he said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

verses.text: Then his ears were opened, and the his tongue was loosened, and he spoke clearly.
Jesus commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, the more widely they proclaimed it.
They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done everything well. He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

verses.heading: Jesus Feeds the Four Thousand / Jesus Feeds the Four Thousand
verses.text: In those days, again there was a very great crowd, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called his disciples and said to them,
“I have gut-wrenching sympathy for the multitude, because they have already stayed with me three days and have nothing to eat.
verses.html: “I have gut-wrenching sympathy for the multitude, because they have already stayed with me three days and have nothing to eat.

verses.text: If I send them to their home hungry, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long distance.”
verses.html: If I send them to their home hungry, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long distance.”

verses.text: His disciples answered him, “Where could anyone get enough bread here in a deserted place to satisfy these people?”
He asked them, “How many loaves do y’all have?” They said, “Seven.”
verses.html:
He asked them, “How many loaves do y’all have?”
They said, “Seven.”

verses.text: He directed the crowd to sit down on the ground. He took the seven loaves and gave thanks, then he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the crowd.
They also had a few small fish. He blessed them, and he said to serve these also.
The people ate and were satisfied. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
About four thousand were there. Then he sent them away.

verses.heading: A Generation Seeks a Sign / A Generation Seeks a Sign
verses.text: Immediately he got into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven to test him.
He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? I tell y’all, no sign will be given to this generation.”
verses.html: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? I tell y’all, no sign will be given to this generation.”

verses.text: He left them, got back into the boat, and departed to the other side.

verses.heading: The Yeast of the Pharisees and Herod / The Yeast of the Pharisees and Herod
verses.text: They had forgotten to take bread, except for the one loaf they had with them in the boat.
He warned them, saying, “Y’all watch out! Y’all beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
verses.html: He warned them, saying, “Y’all watch out! Y’all beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

verses.text: They discussed this with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
