Aware of this, he said to them, “Why are y’all talking about not having bread? Do y’all still not perceive or understand? Do y’all still have a hardened heart?
verses.html: Aware of this, he said to them, “Why are y’all talking about not having bread? Do y’all still not perceive or understand? Do y’all still have a hardened heart?

verses.text: Having eyes, don’t y’all see? Having ears, don’t y’all hear? Don’t y’all remember
verses.html: Having eyes, don’t y’all see? Having ears, don’t y’all hear? Don’t y’all remember

verses.text: when I broke the five loaves among the five thousand? How many baskets full of broken pieces did y’all take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
verses.html:
when I broke the five loaves among the five thousand? How many baskets full of broken pieces did y’all take up?”
They told him, “Twelve.”

verses.text: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did y’all take up?” They said, “Seven.”
verses.html:
“When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did y’all take up?”
They said, “Seven.”

verses.text: Then he said to them, “Do y’all still not understand?”
verses.html: Then he said to them, “Do y’all still not understand?”

verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Blind Man at Bethsaida / Jesus Heals a Blind Man at Bethsaida
verses.text: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.
He took the blind man by the hand and brought him outside the village. He spat on his eyes, laid his hands on him, and asked him, “Do you see anything?”
verses.html: He took the blind man by the hand and brought him outside the village. He spat on his eyes, laid his hands on him, and asked him, “Do you see anything?”

verses.text: He looked up and said, “I see humans, but I see them like walking trees.”
Then he laid his hands on his eyes again. The man looked intently and was restored, and he began seeing everything clearly.
He sent him to his house, saying, “Don’t even go into the village.”
verses.html: He sent him to his house, saying, “Don’t even go into the village.”

verses.heading: Peter Declares That Jesus Is the Christ / Peter Declares That Jesus Is the Christ
verses.text: Jesus and his disciples went to the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do humans say that I am?”
verses.html: Jesus and his disciples went to the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do humans say that I am?”

verses.text: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, and still others, one of the prophets.”
He continued to question them, “But who do y’all say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
verses.html:
He continued to question them, “But who do y’all say that I am?”
Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

verses.text: Then he commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
He began to teach them that the Son of Humanity must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and that he must be killed, and after three days rise again.
He spoke to them openly. Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.
But turning around and seeing his disciples, he rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on human things.”
verses.html: But turning around and seeing his disciples, he rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on human things.”

verses.heading: The Way of the Cross / The Way of the Cross
verses.text: He called the crowd to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to follow after me, must deny themselves, and take up their cross, and follow me.
verses.html: He called the crowd to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to follow after me, must deny themselves, and take up their cross, and follow me.

verses.text: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it; and whoever wants to lose their life for my sake and the sake of the gospel will save it.
verses.html: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it; and whoever wants to lose their life for my sake and the sake of the gospel will save it.

verses.text: For what does it profit a human to gain the whole world and forfeit their life?
verses.html: For what does it profit a human to gain the whole world and forfeit their life?

verses.text: For what will a human give in exchange for their life?
verses.html: For what will a human give in exchange for their life?

verses.text: For whoever is ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Humanity also will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
verses.html: For whoever is ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Humanity also will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

verses.text: He said to them, “I tell y’all, there are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the Empire of God come with power.”
verses.html: He said to them, “I tell y’all, there are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the Empire of God come with power.”

verses.heading: The Transfiguration / The Transfiguration
verses.text: After six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John with him, and led them up a high mountain by themselves. He was transfigured in front of them.
His clothing became radiant and exceedingly white, more than any launderer on earth could whiten them.
Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is excellent for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
(He didn’t know what to say, they were so afraid.)
A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Y’all listen to him.”
Suddenly, when they looked around, they no longer saw anyone except Jesus with them.
As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what they had seen, until after the Son of Humanity had risen from the dead.
They kept this matter to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
Then they asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. Why is it written that the Son of Humanity should suffer many things and be despised?
verses.html: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. Why is it written that the Son of Humanity should suffer many things and be despised?

verses.text: But I tell y’all that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted, just as it is written about him.”
verses.html: But I tell y’all that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted, just as it is written about him.”

verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Boy with an Evil Spirit / Jesus Heals a Boy with an Evil Spirit
verses.text: When they returned to the disciples, they saw a large crowd around them, and scribes questioning them.
Immediately when all the crowd saw him, they were greatly amazed and ran to greet him.
He asked the scribes, “What are y’all questioning them about?”
verses.html: He asked the scribes, “What are y’all questioning them about?”

verses.text: One from the crowd answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a spirit that makes him mute.
Wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, but they couldn’t.”
He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long must I stay with y’all? How long should I endure y’all? Y’all bring him to me.”
verses.html: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long must I stay with y’all? How long should I endure y’all? Y’all bring him to me.”

verses.text: They brought the boy to him, and when the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw him into a convulsion, and he fell on the ground, rolling around and foaming at the mouth.
He asked his father, “How long has this been happening to him?” He said, “Since childhood.
verses.html:
He asked his father, “How long has this been happening to him?”
He said, “Since childhood.

verses.text: It has thrown him into fire or water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, feel gut-wrenching sympathy toward us and help us.”
Jesus said to him, “‘If you can’? All things are possible to him who believes.”
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “‘If you can’? All things are possible to him who believes.”

verses.text: Immediately the child’s father cried out and said, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
When Jesus saw that a crowd was rapidly gathering, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
verses.html: When Jesus saw that a crowd was rapidly gathering, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

verses.text: After crying out and causing him to convulse, it came out of him. The boy became like a corpse, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up. And he arose.
When he came into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
He said to them, “This kind can only come out by prayer.”
verses.html: He said to them, “This kind can only come out by prayer.”

verses.heading: Death, Resurrection, and Greatness / Death, Resurrection, and Greatness
verses.text: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know,

because he was teaching his disciples. He said to them, “The Son of Humanity is going to be handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him. After he has been killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
verses.html: because he was teaching his disciples. He said to them, “The Son of Humanity is going to be handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him. After he has been killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

verses.text: But they didn’t understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask him.
He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were y’all discussing on the way?”
verses.html: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were y’all discussing on the way?”

verses.text: But they kept silent, because on the way they had argued about who was the greatest.
Sitting down, he called the twelve, and he said to them, “If anyone wants to be first, that person will be last of all and deacon of all.”
verses.html: Sitting down, he called the twelve, and he said to them, “If anyone wants to be first, that person will be last of all and deacon of all.”

verses.text: He took a little child whom he placed in the middle of them. Then embracing the child, he said to them,
“Whoever receives one of these little children in my name receives me. And whoever receives me, does not receive me, but the one who sent me.”
verses.html: “Whoever receives one of these little children in my name receives me. And whoever receives me, does not receive me, but the one who sent me.”

verses.heading: Whoever Is Not Against Us Is for Us / Whoever Is Not Against Us Is for Us
verses.text: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name, so we stopped him, because he doesn’t follow us.”
But Jesus said, “Y’all must not stop him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
verses.html: But Jesus said, “Y’all must not stop him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

verses.text: For whoever is not against us is for us.
verses.html: For whoever is not against us is for us.

verses.text: Truly I tell y’all, anyone who gives y’all a cup of water to drink in my name because y’all are of Christ will not lose their reward.
verses.html: Truly I tell y’all, anyone who gives y’all a cup of water to drink in my name because y’all are of Christ will not lose their reward.

verses.heading: Causing Little Ones to Stumble / Causing Little Ones to Stumble
verses.text: “Whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be more excellent for them if they were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around their neck.
verses.html: “Whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be more excellent for them if they were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around their neck.

verses.text: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is more beautiful for you to enter life maimed than to have two hands and go to hell where the fire is unquenchable.
verses.html: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is more beautiful for you to enter life maimed than to have two hands and go to hell where the fire is unquenchable.

verses.text: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is more beautiful for you to enter life lame than to be thrown into hell with two feet.
verses.html: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is more beautiful for you to enter life lame than to be thrown into hell with two feet.

verses.text: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is more beautiful for you to enter into the Empire of God with one eye than to be thrown into hell with two eyes
verses.html: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is more beautiful for you to enter into the Empire of God with one eye than to be thrown into hell with two eyes

verses.text: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is never quenched.’
verses.html: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is never quenched.’

verses.text: For everyone will be salted with fire.
verses.html: For everyone will be salted with fire.

verses.text: Salt is excellent, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, how can y’all make it salty again? Y’all should have salt in yourselves and be at peace with one another.”
verses.html: Salt is excellent, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, how can y’all make it salty again? Y’all should have salt in yourselves and be at peace with one another.”

verses.heading: Divorce / Divorce
verses.text: He left that place and came into the region of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Again, crowds gathered around him, and as was his custom, he began to teach them.
Some Pharisees came and asked, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?” (They were testing him).
He answered and said to them, “What did Moses command y’all?”
verses.html: He answered and said to them, “What did Moses command y’all?”

verses.text: They said, “Moses allowed a scroll of divorce to be written, and to send her away.”
But Jesus said to them, “It was because of y’all’s hardness of heart that he wrote this commandment for y’all.
verses.html: But Jesus said to them, “It was because of y’all’s hardness of heart that he wrote this commandment for y’all.

verses.text: But from the beginning of the creation, God ‘made them male and female.’
verses.html: But from the beginning of the creation, God ‘made them male and female.’

verses.text: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother,
verses.html: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother,

verses.text: and the two will become one flesh.’ So that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
verses.html: and the two will become one flesh.’ So that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

verses.text: What therefore God has joined together, let no human separate.”
verses.html: What therefore God has joined together, let no human separate.”

verses.text: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.
verses.html: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

verses.text: If a woman divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”
verses.html: If a woman divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

verses.heading: Jesus Blesses the Little Children / Jesus Blesses the Little Children
verses.text: People were bringing little children to him for him to touch, but the disciples rebuked them.
When Jesus saw this, he was indignant and said to them, “Y’all are to let the little children come to me! Y’all must not stop them, for the Empire of God belongs to ones like these.
verses.html: When Jesus saw this, he was indignant and said to them, “Y’all are to let the little children come to me! Y’all must not stop them, for the Empire of God belongs to ones like these.

verses.text: I tell y’all, whoever will not receive the Empire of God like a little child will never enter it.”
verses.html: I tell y’all, whoever will not receive the Empire of God like a little child will never enter it.”

verses.text: He took them in his arms, placing his hands on them and blessed them.

verses.heading: Riches and the Empire of God / Riches and the Empire of God
verses.text: As he started out on his way, a man ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except God alone.
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except God alone.

verses.text: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, Do not commit adultery, Do not steal, Do not give false testimony, Do not defraud, Honor your father and mother.’”
verses.html: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, Do not commit adultery, Do not steal, Do not give false testimony, Do not defraud, Honor your father and mother.’”

verses.text: He said to him, “Teacher, I have kept all these since my youth.”
Looking at him, Jesus loved him and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”
verses.html: Looking at him, Jesus loved him and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”

verses.text: But his face fell at these words, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.
Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into the Empire of God!”
verses.html: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into the Empire of God!”

verses.text: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how difficult it is to enter into the Empire of God!
verses.html: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how difficult it is to enter into the Empire of God!

verses.text: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter into the Empire of God.”
verses.html: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter into the Empire of God.”

verses.text: They were even more amazed, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
Jesus, looking at them, said, “This is impossible for humans, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
verses.html: Jesus, looking at them, said, “This is impossible for humans, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

verses.text: Peter began to tell him, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
Jesus said, “I tell y’all, there is no one who has left house or brother or sister or father or mother or wife or children or land for my sake and for the sake of the gospel,
verses.html: Jesus said, “I tell y’all, there is no one who has left house or brother or sister or father or mother or wife or children or land for my sake and for the sake of the gospel,

verses.text: who will not receive one hundred times more now in this present age: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.
verses.html: who will not receive one hundred times more now in this present age: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

verses.text: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”
verses.html: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death a Third Time / Jesus Foretells His Death a Third Time
verses.text: They were on the way going up to Jerusalem. Jesus was going ahead of them, and they were amazed, but those who followed were afraid. Again, he took the twelve aside, and began to tell them what was going to happen to him.
“See, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Humanity will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death and will deliver him to the ethnic groups.
verses.html: “See, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Humanity will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death and will deliver him to the ethnic groups.

verses.text: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”
verses.html: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

verses.text: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
He said to them, “What do y’all want me to do for y’all?”
verses.html: He said to them, “What do y’all want me to do for y’all?”

verses.text: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right and one at your left, in your glory.”
But Jesus said to them, “Y’all don’t know what y’all are asking. Are y’all able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
verses.html: But Jesus said to them, “Y’all don’t know what y’all are asking. Are y’all able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

verses.text: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “Y’all will drink the cup that I drink, and y’all will be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with;
verses.html:
They said to him, “We are able.”
Jesus said to them, “Y’all will drink the cup that I drink, and y’all will be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with;

verses.text: but to sit at my right or my left is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
verses.html: but to sit at my right or my left is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

verses.text: When the ten heard this, they began to feel indignant toward James and John.
Jesus summoned them and said to them, “Y’all know that those who are recognized as rulers over the ethnic groups lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.html: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “Y’all know that those who are recognized as rulers over the ethnic groups lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

verses.text: But it is not so among y’all. Instead whoever wants to become great among y’all must be y’all’s deacon.
verses.html: But it is not so among y’all. Instead whoever wants to become great among y’all must be y’all’s deacon.

verses.text: Whoever wants to become first among y’all must be a slave of all.
verses.html: Whoever wants to become first among y’all must be a slave of all.

verses.text: For the Son of Humanity also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
verses.html: For the Son of Humanity also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

verses.heading: Blind Bartimaeus Receives Sight / Blind Bartimaeus Receives Sight
verses.text: Then they came to Jericho. As he was leaving Jericho with his disciples and a large crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting by the road.
When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me!”
Many rebuked him so that he would be quiet, but he cried out all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
Jesus stood still and said, “Y’all call him.” So they called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up and rise up! He is calling you!”
verses.html:
Jesus stood still and said, “Y’all call him.”
So they called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up and rise up! He is calling you!”

verses.text: Throwing aside his cloak, he jumped up and came to Jesus.
Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabbi, I want to see again.”
verses.html:
Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?”
The blind man said to him, “Rabbi, I want to see again.”

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “Go, your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “Go, your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.

verses.heading: Jesus Honored as King in Jerusalem / Jesus Honored as King in Jerusalem
verses.text: When they approached Jerusalem, near Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples
and said to them, “Y’all go to the village ahead. Immediately as y’all enter, y’all will find a colt tied there, on which no human has sat. Y’all untie him and bring him.
verses.html: and said to them, “Y’all go to the village ahead. Immediately as y’all enter, y’all will find a colt tied there, on which no human has sat. Y’all untie him and bring him.

verses.text: If anyone asks y’all, ‘Why are y’all doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it, and he will send it back here soon.’”
verses.html: If anyone asks y’all, ‘Why are y’all doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it, and he will send it back here soon.’”

verses.text: They went and found a colt tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
Some bystanders there said to them, “What are y’all doing, untying the colt?”
They said to them just as Jesus had said, and the bystanders let them go.
They brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks on it, and he sat on it.
Many spread their cloaks on the road, and others spread branches they had cut down from the fields.
Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord [YHWH]!
Blessed is the coming empire of our father David! Hosanna in the highest!”
Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

verses.heading: Cursing the Fig Tree / Cursing the Fig Tree
verses.text: The next day, as they were leaving Bethany, he became hungry.
Seeing a fig tree in the distance with leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.
Jesus said to the tree, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
verses.html: Jesus said to the tree, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

verses.heading: Driving the Money Changers from the Temple / Driving the Money Changers from the Temple
verses.text: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered the temple and began to throw out those who were buying and selling in the temple. He over turned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who were selling doves.
He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple.
He taught them, saying, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the ethnic groups?’ But y’all have made it a den of robbers!”
verses.html: He taught them, saying, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the ethnic groups?’ But y’all have made it a den of robbers!”

verses.text: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and began considering how they might kill him, for they feared him, because the whole crowd was amazed at his teaching.
When evening came, they left the city.
In the morning, as they were passing by, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.
Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
Jesus answered them, “Y’all have faith in God.
verses.html: Jesus answered them, “Y’all have faith in God.

verses.text: For I tell y’all, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in their heart, but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.
verses.html: For I tell y’all, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in their heart, but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.

verses.text: Therefore I tell y’all, all things y’all pray and ask for, y’all believe that y’all have received them, and they will be granted to y’all.
verses.html: Therefore I tell y’all, all things y’all pray and ask for, y’all believe that y’all have received them, and they will be granted to y’all.

verses.text: Whenever y’all stand praying, if y’all have anything against anyone, y’all are to tell them so that your* Father who is in heaven may also forgive y’all of your* transgressions.
verses.html: Whenever y’all stand praying, if y’all have anything against anyone, y’all are to tell them so that your* Father who is in heaven may also forgive y’all of your* transgressions.

verses.heading: The Authority of Jesus Questioned / The Authority of Jesus Questioned
verses.text: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,
and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”
Jesus said to them, “I will ask y’all one question. Answer me, and I will tell y’all by what authority I do these things.
verses.html: Jesus said to them, “I will ask y’all one question. Answer me, and I will tell y’all by what authority I do these things.

verses.text: Was the baptism of John from heaven, or of human origin? Y’all give me an answer.”
verses.html: Was the baptism of John from heaven, or of human origin? Y’all give me an answer.”

verses.text: They discussed among themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Then why didn’t y’all believe him?’
But if we say, ‘Of human origin—’” (They feared the crowd, for everyone considered John to be a true prophet.)
They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell y’all by what authority I do these things.”
verses.html:
They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.”
Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell y’all by what authority I do these things.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Tenants / The Parable of the Tenants
verses.text: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some farmers and went into another country.
verses.html: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some farmers and went into another country.

verses.text: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmers to get from them his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.html: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmers to get from them his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

verses.text: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.html: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

verses.text: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
verses.html: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

verses.text: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some and killing others.
verses.html: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some and killing others.

verses.text: He had one left, his beloved son. He sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.html: He had one left, his beloved son. He sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

verses.text: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.html: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

verses.text: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.html: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

verses.text: What then will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
verses.html: What then will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

verses.text: Haven’t y’all even read this Scripture: ‘The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.html:
Haven’t y’all even read this Scripture:
‘The stone that the builders rejected
has become the cornerstone.

verses.text: This was from the Lord [YHWH]. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”
verses.html:
This was from the Lord [YHWH].
It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

verses.text: Then they tried to seize him, but they feared the crowd, for they perceived that he spoken the parable against them. They left him and went away.

verses.heading: Paying What Is Due / Paying What Is Due
verses.text: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, in order to trap him with words.

When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are truthful, and you are not concerned about anyone because you don’t focus on the face of humans, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
Should we pay or shouldn’t we?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why are y’all testing me? Y’all bring me a denarius to look at.”
verses.html:
Should we pay or shouldn’t we?”
But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why are y’all testing me? Y’all bring me a denarius to look at.”

verses.text: They brought the coint. He said to them, “Whose image and inscription is this?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
verses.html:
They brought the coint.
He said to them, “Whose image and inscription is this?”
They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Y’all are to give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
verses.html:
Jesus answered them, “Y’all are to give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
They marveled greatly at him.

verses.heading: Marriage at the Resurrection / Marriage at the Resurrection
verses.text: Some Sadducees (who say there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him, saying,
“Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves behind a wife and no children, his brother should marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died leaving no children.
The second one married her, and died, leaving no children. The third likewise,
and so the seven left no children. Last of all, the woman died also.
In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be? For all seven had her as a wife.”
Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this the reason y’all are in error, not knowing the Scriptures or the power of God?
verses.html: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this the reason y’all are in error, not knowing the Scriptures or the power of God?

verses.text: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.html: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

verses.text: Now as for the dead being raised, haven’t y’all read in the book of Moses about the bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.html: Now as for the dead being raised, haven’t y’all read in the book of Moses about the bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

verses.text: Hᴇ is not the God of the dead, but of the living. Y’all are greatly mistaken.”
verses.html: Hᴇ is not the God of the dead, but of the living. Y’all are greatly mistaken.”

verses.heading: The Greatest Commandment / The Greatest Commandment
verses.text: One of the scribes came and heard them debating. Recognizing that Jesus had answered them well, he asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord [YHWH] our God, the Lord[YHWH] is one.
verses.html: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord [YHWH] our God, the Lord[YHWH] is one.

verses.text: You are to love the Lord [YHWH] your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’
verses.html: You are to love the Lord [YHWH] your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’

verses.text: The second is like this: ‘You are to love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
verses.html: The second is like this: ‘You are to love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

verses.text: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that ʜᴇ is one, and there is none other but ʜᴇ;

and to love ʜɪᴍ with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the Empire of God.” No one dared ask him any question after that.
verses.html:
When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the Empire of God.”
No one dared ask him any question after that.

verses.heading: Jesus Explains a Trinitarian Psalm / Jesus Explains a Trinitarian Psalm
verses.text: Jesus was teaching in the temple, saying, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
verses.html: Jesus was teaching in the temple, saying, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

verses.text: For David himself, speaking by the Holy Spirit, said ‘The Lord [YHWH] said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
verses.html:

‘The Lord [YHWH] said to my Lord,
“Sit at my right hand,
until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

verses.text: If David himself calls him ‘Lord,’ then how can he be his son?” The large crowd heard him with delight.
verses.html:
If David himself calls him ‘Lord,’ then how can he be his son?”
The large crowd heard him with delight.

verses.text: In his teaching, he said, “Y’all beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
verses.html: In his teaching, he said, “Y’all beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

verses.text: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
verses.html: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

verses.text: They devour widows’ houses, and for appearance make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
verses.html: They devour widows’ houses, and for appearance make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

verses.heading: The Widow’s Offering / The Widow’s Offering
verses.text: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and watched how the crowd put money into the treasury. Many rich people put in large amounts.
A poor widow came and she put in two small copper coins, worth less than a penny.
He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “I tell y’all, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
verses.html: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “I tell y’all, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

verses.text: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
verses.html: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple / The Destruction of the Temple
verses.text: As he was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, look at these wonderful stones and buildings!”
Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left on another. Every one will be thrown down.”
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left on another. Every one will be thrown down.”

verses.text: As he was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
“Tell us, when will these things happen? What is the sign that these things are about to be fulfilled?”
Jesus began to tell them, “Y’all be careful that no one leads y’all astray.
verses.html: Jesus began to tell them, “Y’all be careful that no one leads y’all astray.

verses.text: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.
verses.html: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

verses.text: “When y’all hear of wars and rumors of wars, y’all don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but this is not yet the end.
verses.html: “When y’all hear of wars and rumors of wars, y’all don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but this is not yet the end.

verses.text: For one ethnic group will rise up against another ethnic group, and empire against empire. There will be earthquakes in various places, and there will be famines. These things are the beginning of birth pains.
verses.html: For one ethnic group will rise up against another ethnic group, and empire against empire. There will be earthquakes in various places, and there will be famines. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

verses.text: “But y’all must be on guard. For they will deliver y’all up to councils, and y’all will be beaten in synagogues. Y’all will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, as a witness to them.
verses.html: “But y’all must be on guard. For they will deliver y’all up to councils, and y’all will be beaten in synagogues. Y’all will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, as a witness to them.

verses.text: The gospel must first be preached to all the ethnic groups.
verses.html: The gospel must first be preached to all the ethnic groups.

verses.text: When they arrest y’all and hand y’all over, y’all don’t worry beforehand about what to say, but y’all say whatever is given to y’all at that time. For it is not y’all who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
verses.html: When they arrest y’all and hand y’all over, y’all don’t worry beforehand about what to say, but y’all say whatever is given to y’all at that time. For it is not y’all who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: “Brother will hand over brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and have them put to death.
verses.html: “Brother will hand over brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and have them put to death.

verses.text: Y’all will be hated by everyone for my name’s sake, but the one who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.html: Y’all will be hated by everyone for my name’s sake, but the one who endures to the end will be saved.

verses.text: “But when y’all see ‘the abomination of desolation,’ standing where it should not be, (let the reader understand) then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
verses.html: “But when y’all see ‘the abomination of desolation,’ standing where it should not be, (let the reader understand) then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

verses.text: The one on the housetop must not go down or go inside to take anything out of their house.
verses.html: The one on the housetop must not go down or go inside to take anything out of their house.

verses.text: The one in the field must not return to get their cloak.
verses.html: The one in the field must not return to get their cloak.

verses.text: But woe to pregnant women and nursing mothers in those days!
verses.html: But woe to pregnant women and nursing mothers in those days!

verses.text: Y’all should pray that it doesn’t happen in the winter.
verses.html: Y’all should pray that it doesn’t happen in the winter.

verses.text: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been since the beginning of the creation that God created until now, and never will be.
verses.html: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been since the beginning of the creation that God created until now, and never will be.

verses.text: If the Lord had not shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the elect, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
verses.html: If the Lord had not shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the elect, whom he chose, he shortened the days.

verses.text: Then if anyone says to y’all, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t y’all believe it.
verses.html: Then if anyone says to y’all, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t y’all believe it.

verses.text: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
verses.html: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.

verses.text: So y’all must be on guard. “I have told y’all everything ahead of time.
verses.html:
So y’all must be on guard.
“I have told y’all everything ahead of time.

verses.text: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,
verses.html: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

verses.text: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.html: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.

verses.text: Then they will see the Son of Humanity coming in clouds with great power and glory.
verses.html: Then they will see the Son of Humanity coming in clouds with great power and glory.

verses.text: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.
verses.html: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.

verses.text: “Y’all must learn the parable from the fig tree: when the branch becomes tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;
verses.html: “Y’all must learn the parable from the fig tree: when the branch becomes tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

verses.text: So also, when y’all see these things coming to pass, y’all know that it is near, at the doors.
verses.html: So also, when y’all see these things coming to pass, y’all know that it is near, at the doors.

verses.text: I say to y’all, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
verses.html: I say to y’all, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

verses.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.html: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

verses.text: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
verses.html: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

verses.text: Y’all must watch and stay alert! For y’all don’t know when the time will come.
verses.html: Y’all must watch and stay alert! For y’all don’t know when the time will come.

verses.text: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his slaves, each assigned their work, and commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.
verses.html: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his slaves, each assigned their work, and commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

verses.text: Y’all, therefore, must keep watch, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
verses.html: Y’all, therefore, must keep watch, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

verses.text: otherwise, if he comes suddenly, he might find y’all sleeping.
verses.html: otherwise, if he comes suddenly, he might find y’all sleeping.

verses.text: What I tell y’all, I tell everyone: Y’all stay alert!”
verses.html: What I tell y’all, I tell everyone: Y’all stay alert!”

verses.heading: Jesus Anointed as the Priests Plot His Death / Jesus Anointed as the Priests Plot His Death
verses.text: Now it was two days before the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might arrest him secretly and kill him.
They said, “But not during the festival, otherwise there might be a riot among the people.”

While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume from pure nard. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.
But some of those present were indignant, saying to one another, “Why has this ointment been wasted?
For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they rebuked her sternly.
But Jesus said, “Y’all leave her alone. Why are y’all bothering her? She has done a beautiful service for me.
verses.html: But Jesus said, “Y’all leave her alone. Why are y’all bothering her? She has done a beautiful service for me.

verses.text: For y’all will always have the poor among y’all, and whenever y’all want, y’all can do them good. But y’all won’t always have me.
verses.html: For y’all will always have the poor among y’all, and whenever y’all want, y’all can do them good. But y’all won’t always have me.

verses.text: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burial.
verses.html: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burial.

verses.text: I tell y’all, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of in memory of her.”
verses.html: I tell y’all, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of in memory of her.”

verses.text: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests in order to betray Jesus to them.
When they heard this, they were glad and promised to give him money. And he began seeking an opportune time to betray him.

verses.heading: The Last Supper / The Last Supper
verses.text: On the first day of Unleavened Bread, when they sacrificed the Passover lamb, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Y’all go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet y’all. Y’all follow him,
verses.html: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Y’all go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet y’all. Y’all follow him,

verses.text: and wherever he enters, y’all say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
verses.html: and wherever he enters, y’all say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

verses.text: He will show y’all a large upper room furnished and ready. Y’all get ready for us there.”
verses.html: He will show y’all a large upper room furnished and ready. Y’all get ready for us there.”

verses.text: His disciples left and came to the city, and found it just as he had told to them, and they prepared the Passover.
When it was evening, he came with the twelve.
As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “I tell y’all, one of y’all will betray me—one who is eating with me.”
verses.html: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “I tell y’all, one of y’all will betray me—one who is eating with me.”

verses.text: They were sorrowful, and one by one they said to him, “Surely not I?”
He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, the one who dips with me in the dish.
verses.html: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, the one who dips with me in the dish.

verses.text: For the Son of Humanity will go just as it is written about him, but woe to that human by whom the Son of Humanity is betrayed! It would be more excellent for that human if they had not been born.”
verses.html: For the Son of Humanity will go just as it is written about him, but woe to that human by whom the Son of Humanity is betrayed! It would be more excellent for that human if they had not been born.”

verses.text: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave it to them, and said, “Y’all take it. This is my body.”
verses.html: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave it to them, and said, “Y’all take it. This is my body.”

verses.text: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them. They all drank from it.
He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
verses.html: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

verses.text: Truly I tell y’all, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in the Empire of God.”
verses.html: Truly I tell y’all, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in the Empire of God.”

verses.text: After singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.heading: Peter’s Denial and the Disciple’s Falling Away / Peter’s Denial and the Disciple’s Falling Away
verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Y’all will all fall away because of me, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
verses.html: Jesus said to them, “Y’all will all fall away because of me, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

verses.text: However, after I have been raised, I will go ahead of y’all into Galilee.”
verses.html: However, after I have been raised, I will go ahead of y’all into Galilee.”

verses.text: But Peter said to him, “Even if all fall away, yet I will not.”
Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you that today, this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you that today, this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

verses.text: But he spoke emphatically, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

verses.heading: Prayers at Gethsemane / Prayers at Gethsemane
verses.text: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He told his disciples, “Y’all sit here while I pray.”
verses.html: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He told his disciples, “Y’all sit here while I pray.”

verses.text: He took Peter, James, and John with him, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to the point of death. Y’all stay here and keep watch.”
verses.html: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to the point of death. Y’all stay here and keep watch.”

verses.text: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet, not what I will, but what you will.”
verses.html: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet, not what I will, but what you will.”

verses.text: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you keep watch one hour?
verses.html: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you keep watch one hour?

verses.text: Y’all keep watch and pray, so that y’all don’t fall into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
verses.html: Y’all keep watch and pray, so that y’all don’t fall into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

verses.text: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn’t know what to answer him.
He came the third time and said to them, “Are y’all still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Humanity is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.html: He came the third time and said to them, “Are y’all still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Humanity is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.text: Y’all get up! Let’s go. Look, he who betrays me is approaching.”
verses.html: Y’all get up! Let’s go. Look, he who betrays me is approaching.”

verses.heading: Jesus Arrested / Jesus Arrested
verses.text: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, arrived. With him was a crowd with swords and clubs, sent by the chief priests, scribes, and elders.
Now his betrayer had given them a signal, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, he is the one. Y’all arrest him, and y’all lead him away under guard.”
When he arrived, he immediately went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi!” and kissed him.
They seized on him and arrested him.
But a certain one of the bystanders drew his sword and struck the high priest’s slave, cutting off his ear.
Jesus answered them, “Have y’all come out with swords and clubs to capture me like a robber?
verses.html: Jesus answered them, “Have y’all come out with swords and clubs to capture me like a robber?

verses.text: Every day I was with y’all in the temple teaching, and y’all didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
verses.html: Every day I was with y’all in the temple teaching, and y’all didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

verses.text: Then everyone left him and fled.
One young man followed him, wearing only a linen cloth around his body. When they tried to arrest him,
he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

verses.heading: Jesus Before the Council / Jesus Before the Council
verses.text: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together.
Peter followed him from a distance, until he came into the courtyard of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers and warming himself at the fire.
Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, but they did not find any.
Many gave false testimony against him, but their testimonies didn’t agree.
Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
“We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
Yet even in this, their testimony didn’t agree.
The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is this that they are testifying against you?”
But he kept silent and did not answer. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?”
Jesus said, “I am. Y’all will see the Son of Humanity sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
verses.html: Jesus said, “I am. Y’all will see the Son of Humanity sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

verses.text: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need do have we for witnesses?
Y’all have heard the blasphemy! What do y’all think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers also took him and beat him.

verses.heading: Peters Denials / Peters Denials
verses.text: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came
When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
But he denied it, saying, “I don’t know or understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and a rooster crowed.
The maid saw him and began again to tell the bystanders, “This is one of them.”
But again he denied it. After a little while those who stood by said to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean.”
But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man y’all are taking about!”
Immediately, the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” Then he broke down and wept.
verses.html: Immediately, the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” Then he broke down and wept.

verses.heading: Jesus Before Pilate / Jesus Before Pilate
verses.text: Early in the morning the chief priests, along with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation. They bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
verses.html:
Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
He answered, “So you say.”

verses.text: The chief priests accused him of many things.
Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
Now, at the feast, he would release one prisoner to them, whomever they requested.
A man called Barabbas was imprisoned with his fellow insurrectionists, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
The crowd came up and began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
Pilate answered them, saying, “Do y’all want me to release the King of the Jews for y’all?”
For he knew that the chief priests had handed him over because of envy.
But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead.
Pilate again asked them, “Then what do y’all want me to do to the one y’all call the King of the Jews?”
They shouted back, “Crucify him!”
Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they yelled even louder, “Crucify him!”
Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them. Then after having Jesus flogged, he handed him over to be crucified.

verses.heading: Jesus Mocked by the Soldiers / Jesus Mocked by the Soldiers
verses.text: The soldiers led him away within the court (that is, the Praetorium), and they called together the whole cohort.
They clothed him with purple, then weaved a crown of thorns and put it on him.
They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
They struck his head with a reed and spat on him. Then they fell on their knees and paid homage to him.
When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him and put his own garments on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.

verses.heading: The Crucifixion / The Crucifixion
verses.text: They forced someone who was passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene (the father of Alexander and Rufus) to go with them that he might carry the cross.
They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is translated, “The place of a skull.”
They offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he didn’t take it.
And they crucified him. They divided up his garments among them, casting lots for what each would take.
It was the third hour when they crucified him.
The inscription of the charge against him read: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
They crucified two robbers with him, one on his right hand, and one on his left.
Those who passed by insulted him, shaking their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,
save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
Likewise, the chief priests with the scribes mocked him among themselves saying, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
Let this Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, so that we may see and believe.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

verses.heading: Jesus Cries Out to the Father and Dies / Jesus Cries Out to the Father and Dies
verses.text: Now when it was noon, darkness came over the whole land for three hours.
At three in the afternoon, Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” (which is translated, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”)
verses.html: At three in the afternoon, Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” (which is translated, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”)

verses.text: When some of those who stood by heard it, they said, “Look, he is calling for Elijah.”
Someone ran and filled a sponge with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Y’all leave him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
But Jesus cried out with a loud voice and breathed his last.
The temple veil was torn in two from top to bottom.
When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
There were also women watching from afar. Among them were Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome.
When he was in Galilee, they followed him and served him. And many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem were there.

verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus / The Burial of Jesus
verses.text: When evening had come, because it was the Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath),
Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for the Empire of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
Pilate was marveled to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
When he was informed by the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
He bought a linen cloth, took him down, wrapped him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb cut out of a rock. Then he rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses saw where he was laid.

verses.heading: The Resurrection / The Resurrection
verses.text: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, so that they might come and anoint him.
Very early on the first day of the week, after the sun had risen, they went to the tomb.
They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance to the tomb for us?”
Looking up, they saw that the stone had been rolled back, though it was massive.
As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
He said to them, “Y’all don’t be alarmed. You* are looking for Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!
But y’all must go and tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before y’all into Galilee. There you* will see him, just as he told y’all.’”

Then they went out and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had seized them. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid. [Many early manuscripts do not include the text of verses 9-20.]

verses.heading: The Longer Ending of Mark / The Longer Ending of Mark
verses.text: [Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they didn’t believe.
After these things he appeared in another form to two of them as they were walking in the country.
They went back and reported this to the others, but they didn’t believe them either.

Afterward, he appeared to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table. He rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
He said to them, “Y’all go into all the world and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
verses.html: He said to them, “Y’all go into all the world and preach the gospel to the whole creation.

verses.text: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved; but whoever doesn’t believe will be condemned.
verses.html: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved; but whoever doesn’t believe will be condemned.

verses.text: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons, they will speak with new tongues;
verses.html: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons, they will speak with new tongues;

verses.text: they will pick up snakes, and if they drink poison, it will not hurt them. They will lay hands on the sick, and they will get well.”
verses.html: they will pick up snakes, and if they drink poison, it will not hurt them. They will lay hands on the sick, and they will get well.”

verses.text: So then, after the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.]

verses.heading: Introduction / Introduction
verses.text: Many have undertaken to compose a narrative about the things which have been fulfilled among us,
just as they were handed down to us from those who were eyewitnesses and servants of the word from the beginning.
Having investigated everything carefully from the beginning, it seemed good to me to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
so that you might know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

verses.heading: The Birth of John the Baptist Foretold / The Birth of John the Baptist Foretold
verses.text: During the reign of Herod, king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, of the priestly division of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was one of the daughters of Aaron.
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commands and decrees of the Lord.
But they had no child, because Elizabeth could not conceive, and they both were very old.
Now while Zechariah was serving as a priest before God when his division was on duty,
he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
The whole crowd of people were praying outside at the hour of incense offering.
Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
When Zechariah saw the angel, he was terrified and fear gripped him.
But the angel told him, “Don’t be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to name him John.
He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice at his birth,
for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He must never drink wine or spirits, but he will be filled with the Holy Spirit while still in his mother’s womb.
He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

And he will go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the parents to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.”
Zechariah asked the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.”
The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
Now listen: because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their appointed time, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens.”
Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and marveled that he was delayed in the temple.
When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple, because he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.
When his time of service was completed, he departed to his house.
Some time after this, his wife Elizabeth conceived, and she kept herself in seclusion for five months, saying,
“This is what the Lord has done for me. In these days ʜᴇ looked with favor upon me to take away my disgrace among the people.”

verses.heading: An Angel Announces Jesus’s Conception, and Mary Consents / An Angel Announces Jesus’s Conception, and Mary Consents
verses.text: Now in the sixth month of Elizabeth’s pregnancy, God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, a town in Galilee,
to a virgin pledged to be married to a man named Joseph, a descendant of the house of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.
The angel came to her and said, “Rejoice, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.”
But she was deeply troubled at his words and began to wonder what kind of greeting this might be.
The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
Listen: you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and you will name him Jesus.
He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,
and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. And his empire will never end.”
Mary said to the angel, “How will this be, since I have not been intimate with a man?”
The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore the one who is to be born will be holy and will be called the Son of God.
And look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age. She who was called barren is now in her sixth month!
For no word from God will ever fail to happen.
Mary said, “Yes, I am a slave of the Lord. Let this happen to me according to your word.” Then, the angel departed from her.

verses.heading: Mary Visits Elizabeth / Mary Visits Elizabeth
verses.text: Soon afterward, Mary arose and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah,
where she entered the house of Zachariah and greeted Elizabeth.
When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
She exclaimed with a loud voice, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
How could this happen to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
For the moment when the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby leaped for joy in my womb!
Blessed is she who believed that the Lord would fulfill what he said to her!”

verses.heading: Mary’s Song / Mary’s Song
verses.text: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
My spirit rejoices in God my Savior,
for ʜᴇ has looked upon the humble state of his slave. Surely, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
For the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is ʜɪꜱ name.
Hɪꜱ mercy is upon generations after generations on those who fear ʜɪᴍ.
Hᴇ has done mighty deeds with ʜɪꜱ arm. Hᴇ has scattered those who are arrogant in their hearts and minds.
Hᴇ has brought down rulers from their thrones, and has exalted the humble.
Hᴇ has filled the hungry with good things, and has sent the rich away empty.
Hᴇ has helped ʜɪꜱ servant Israel, remembering to be merciful,
as ʜᴇ spoke to our ancestors, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned to her home.

verses.heading: The Birth of John the Baptizer / The Birth of John the Baptizer
verses.text: Now the time came for Elizabeth to have her baby, and she gave birth to a son.
Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had shown his great mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him Zachariah after his father.
His mother answered, “No! He is to be called John.”
They said to her, “None of your relatives is called by that name.”
They made signs to his father to find out what he wanted him to be called.
He asked for a writing tablet on which he wrote, “His name is John.” And they all marveled.
Immediately, his mouth was opened and his tongue freed, and he began to speak, blessing God.
Fear came upon everyone who lived around them, and throughout all the hill country of Judea people were talking about all that had happened.
Everyone who heard them took it to heart, saying, “What then will this child become?” For the hand of the Lord was with him.

verses.heading: Zechariah’s Song / Zechariah’s Song
verses.text: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied,
“Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for ʜᴇ has visited and redeemed ʜɪꜱ people.
Hᴇ has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of ʜɪꜱ servant David
As ʜᴇ said by the mouth of ʜɪꜱ holy prophets from long ago,
salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,
to show mercy toward our ancestors, to remember ʜɪꜱ holy covenant,
the oath which ʜᴇ swore to our father Abraham:
that we, being delivered from the hand of our enemies, should serve ʜɪᴍ without fear,
in holiness and righteousness before ʜɪᴍ all of our days.
And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare ʜɪꜱ ways,
to give ʜɪꜱ people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,
because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the sunrise from on high will visit us,
to shine on those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
The child grew and became strong in spirit, and he lived in the wilderness until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus / The Birth of Jesus
verses.text: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of all the known world.
This was the first census taken when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
And everyone went to register, each to their own town.
Joseph also went up from the town of Nazareth in Galilee into Judea, Bethlehem, the city of David, because he was from the house and family of David.
He went to register with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him and was expecting a child.
While they were there, the time had come for her to give birth,
