verses.html: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is finished!

verses.text: Do y’all think that I have come to bring peace on earth? No, I tell y’all, but rather division.
verses.html: Do y’all think that I have come to bring peace on earth? No, I tell y’all, but rather division.

verses.text: For from now on, a household of five will be divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.html: For from now on, a household of five will be divided, three against two, and two against three.

verses.text: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father, mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
verses.html: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father, mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

verses.heading: Interpreting the Signs of the Time / Interpreting the Signs of the Time
verses.text: Jesus said to the crowds, “When y’all see a cloud rising from the west, immediately y’all say, ‘A storm is coming,’ and so it does.
verses.html: Jesus said to the crowds, “When y’all see a cloud rising from the west, immediately y’all say, ‘A storm is coming,’ and so it does.

verses.text: And when a south wind blows, y’all say, ‘It’s going to be hot,’ and it is.
verses.html: And when a south wind blows, y’all say, ‘It’s going to be hot,’ and it is.

verses.text: Hypocrites! Y’all know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that y’all don’t know how to interpret the present time?
verses.html: Hypocrites! Y’all know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that y’all don’t know how to interpret the present time?

verses.text: “Why don’t y’all judge for yourselves what is right?
verses.html: “Why don’t y’all judge for yourselves what is right?

verses.text: As you are going with your adversary to appear before the magistrate, make an effort to be reconciled on the way, so that he won’t drag you to the judge, and the judge hands you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
verses.html: As you are going with your adversary to appear before the magistrate, make an effort to be reconciled on the way, so that he won’t drag you to the judge, and the judge hands you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

verses.text: I tell you, you never get out of there until you have paid every last penny.”
verses.html: I tell you, you never get out of there until you have paid every last penny.”

verses.heading: Call to Repentance / Call to Repentance
verses.text: Now there were some present at that time who told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
Jesus answered them, “Do y’all think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this way?
verses.html: Jesus answered them, “Do y’all think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this way?

verses.text: No, I tell y’all! But unless y’all repent, all y’all will perish likewise.
verses.html: No, I tell y’all! But unless y’all repent, all y’all will perish likewise.

verses.text: Or do y’all think those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them were worse offenders than all the other humans who live in Jerusalem?
verses.html: Or do y’all think those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them were worse offenders than all the other humans who live in Jerusalem?

verses.text: No, I tell y’all! But unless y’all repent, all y’all will perish as well.”
verses.html: No, I tell y’all! But unless y’all repent, all y’all will perish as well.”

verses.text: Then he told this parable: “A man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he went looking for fruit on it but didn’t find any.
verses.html: Then he told this parable: “A man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he went looking for fruit on it but didn’t find any.

verses.text: So he said to the vineyard worker, ‘Look, for three years, I have been coming to look for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Cut it down! Why should it waste the soil?’
verses.html: So he said to the vineyard worker, ‘Look, for three years, I have been coming to look for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Cut it down! Why should it waste the soil?’

verses.text: He answered, ‘Sir, leave it alone for one more year, while I dig around it and fertilize it.
verses.html: He answered, ‘Sir, leave it alone for one more year, while I dig around it and fertilize it.

verses.text: If it bears fruit, fine; if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
verses.html: If it bears fruit, fine; if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

verses.heading: Healing a Woman on the Sabbath / Healing a Woman on the Sabbath
verses.text: Now Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath,
and a woman was there who had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten herself up at all.
When Jesus saw her, he called her over and said, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
verses.html: When Jesus saw her, he called her over and said, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

verses.text: Then he laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and began to glorify God.

But the ruler of the synagogue was indignant that Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, and he said to the crowd, “There are six days when work should be done. So y’all should come and be healed on those days, not the Sabbath day!”
The Lord answered him, “Hypocrites! Wouldn’t each one of y’all untie your ox or donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead it to water?
verses.html: The Lord answered him, “Hypocrites! Wouldn’t each one of y’all untie your ox or donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead it to water?

verses.text: Then shouldn’t this woman, a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be untied from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
verses.html: Then shouldn’t this woman, a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be untied from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

verses.text: When he said this, all his adversaries were humiliated, and the whole crowd rejoiced for all the glorious things he was doing.

verses.heading: How the Empire Grows / How the Empire Grows
verses.text: Then he said, “What is the Empire of God like? What might I compare it to?
verses.html: Then he said, “What is the Empire of God like? What might I compare it to?

verses.text: It is like a mustard seed which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the wild birds nested in its branches.”
verses.html: It is like a mustard seed which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the wild birds nested in its branches.”

verses.text: Again he said, “What might I compare the Empire of God to?
verses.html: Again he said, “What might I compare the Empire of God to?

verses.text: It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed in three measures of flour until all of it was leavened.”
verses.html: It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed in three measures of flour until all of it was leavened.”

verses.heading: Take The Narrow Door / Take The Narrow Door
verses.text: Then Jesus traveled throughout the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way toward Jerusalem.
One said to him, “Lord, will only a few people be saved?” He told them,
“Y’all must make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because, I am telling y’all, many will seek to enter in and will not be able.
verses.html: “Y’all must make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because, I am telling y’all, many will seek to enter in and will not be able.

verses.text: Once the master of the house gets up and has shuts the door, y’all will stand outside and knock on the door, saying, ‘Lord, open up for us!’ But he will answer y’all, ‘I don’t know y’all or where y’all come from.’
verses.html: Once the master of the house gets up and has shuts the door, y’all will stand outside and knock on the door, saying, ‘Lord, open up for us!’ But he will answer y’all, ‘I don’t know y’all or where y’all come from.’

verses.text: Then y’all will say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
verses.html: Then y’all will say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

verses.text: He will say, ‘I tell y’all, I don’t know where y’all come from. Depart from me, all y’all evildoers.’
verses.html: He will say, ‘I tell y’all, I don’t know where y’all come from. Depart from me, all y’all evildoers.’

verses.text: In that place, there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when y’all see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the Empire of God, but y’all get thrown out.
verses.html: In that place, there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when y’all see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the Empire of God, but y’all get thrown out.

verses.text: Then people will come from east and west and north and south, they will be seated at the banquet table in the Empire of God.
verses.html: Then people will come from east and west and north and south, they will be seated at the banquet table in the Empire of God.

verses.text: But indeed, some who are last will be first, and the first who will be last.”
verses.html: But indeed, some who are last will be first, and the first who will be last.”

verses.heading: Jesus the Mother Hen / Jesus the Mother Hen
verses.text: At that time, some Pharisees came up and said to Jesus, “You must go and leave this place, because Herod wants to kill you.”
He said to them, “Y’all go and tell that fox, ‘I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and on the third day I complete my work.
verses.html: He said to them, “Y’all go and tell that fox, ‘I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and on the third day I complete my work.

verses.text: Besides, I must travel today and tomorrow and the next day, because it is not possible for a prophet to die outside of Jerusalem.’
verses.html: Besides, I must travel today and tomorrow and the next day, because it is not possible for a prophet to die outside of Jerusalem.’

verses.text: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I longed to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own chicks under her wings, but y’all refused!
verses.html: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I longed to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own chicks under her wings, but y’all refused!

verses.text: Look, y’all’s house is abandoned. I tell y’all, y’all will not see me until y’all say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord [YHWH]!’”
verses.html: Look, y’all’s house is abandoned. I tell y’all, y’all will not see me until y’all say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord [YHWH]!’”

verses.heading: Jesus Heals Again on the Sabbath / Jesus Heals Again on the Sabbath
verses.text: One Sabbath, Jesus went to the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees to eat bread, they were watching him closely.
There in front of him was a man suffering from edema, a swelling under the skin.
In response, Jesus asked the legal experts and Pharisees, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
verses.html: In response, Jesus asked the legal experts and Pharisees, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

verses.text: But they kept silent. So Jesus took the man, healed him, and released him.
He answered them, “Which of y’all, if your son or your ox fell into a well on a Sabbath day, wouldn’t immediately pull it out ?”
verses.html: He answered them, “Which of y’all, if your son or your ox fell into a well on a Sabbath day, wouldn’t immediately pull it out ?”

verses.text: But they could not answer this.
Then when he noticed how the guests chose the places of honor, he told them a parable:
“When someone invites you to a wedding feast, don’t take the place of honor, because someone more respected than you might have been invited.
verses.html: “When someone invites you to a wedding feast, don’t take the place of honor, because someone more respected than you might have been invited.

verses.text: Then the host who invited both of you will come and say to you, ‘Give this person your seat.’ In disgrace, you would then go take the least important place.
verses.html: Then the host who invited both of you will come and say to you, ‘Give this person your seat.’ In disgrace, you would then go take the least important place.

verses.text: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all the other guests.
verses.html: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all the other guests.

verses.text: For everyone who exalts themselves will be humbled, and whoever humbles themself will be exalted.”
verses.html: For everyone who exalts themselves will be humbled, and whoever humbles themself will be exalted.”

verses.text: Then Jesus said to the one who had invited him, “When you give a luncheon or a dinner, don’t invite your friends or your brothers or your relatives or your rich neighbors, otherwise they might invite you in return, and you would be repaid.
verses.html: Then Jesus said to the one who had invited him, “When you give a luncheon or a dinner, don’t invite your friends or your brothers or your relatives or your rich neighbors, otherwise they might invite you in return, and you would be repaid.

verses.text: Instead, when you host a banquet, invite the poor, maimed, lame, and blind,
verses.html: Instead, when you host a banquet, invite the poor, maimed, lame, and blind,

verses.text: and you will be blessed. Because they can’t repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”
verses.html: and you will be blessed. Because they can’t repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”

verses.heading: New Guests for the Banquet / New Guests for the Banquet
verses.text: When one of those reclining at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, “Blessed is the one who will feast in the Empire of God!”
But Jesus said, “A man was giving a great banquet and invited many.
verses.html: But Jesus said, “A man was giving a great banquet and invited many.

verses.text: At the time of the banquet, he sent out his servant to tell those who were invited, ‘Come y’all, everything is ready now.’
verses.html: At the time of the banquet, he sent out his servant to tell those who were invited, ‘Come y’all, everything is ready now.’

verses.text: But every one of them began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.’
verses.html:
But every one of them began to make excuses.
“The first said to him, ‘I bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.’

verses.text: “Another said, ‘I bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’
verses.html: “Another said, ‘I bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’

verses.text: “Another said, ‘I just got married a woman, so I can’t come.’
verses.html: “Another said, ‘I just got married a woman, so I can’t come.’

verses.text: “The servant came back and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house was enraged and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, crippled, blind, and lame.’
verses.html: “The servant came back and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house was enraged and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, crippled, blind, and lame.’

verses.text: “The servant said, ‘Master, what you commanded has been done, but there is still room.’
verses.html: “The servant said, ‘Master, what you commanded has been done, but there is still room.’

verses.text: “Then the master said to the servant, ‘Go out into the roads and along the hedges, and compel them to come in, so that my house may be filled.
verses.html: “Then the master said to the servant, ‘Go out into the roads and along the hedges, and compel them to come in, so that my house may be filled.

verses.text: For I tell y’all that none of those who were invited will taste of my banquet.’”
verses.html: For I tell y’all that none of those who were invited will taste of my banquet.’”

verses.heading: Counting the Cost of Discipleship / Counting the Cost of Discipleship
verses.text: Now large crowds were traveling with him. He turned and said to them,
“If anyone comes to me and doesn’t hate their own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters—yes, even their own life—such a person cannot be my disciple.
verses.html: “If anyone comes to me and doesn’t hate their own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters—yes, even their own life—such a person cannot be my disciple.

verses.text: Whoever does not carry their own cross and follow after me cannot be my disciple.
verses.html: Whoever does not carry their own cross and follow after me cannot be my disciple.

verses.text: For which of y’all, wanting to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost to see if you have enough to complete it?
verses.html: For which of y’all, wanting to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost to see if you have enough to complete it?

verses.text: Otherwise, when you lay the foundation and aren’t able to finish it, everyone who sees it will begin to mock you,
verses.html: Otherwise, when you lay the foundation and aren’t able to finish it, everyone who sees it will begin to mock you,

verses.text: saying, ‘This human began to build but wasn’t able to finish.’
verses.html: saying, ‘This human began to build but wasn’t able to finish.’

verses.text: Or what king, when he goes to battle against another king, will not first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to oppose the one who comes against him with twenty thousand?
verses.html: Or what king, when he goes to battle against another king, will not first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to oppose the one who comes against him with twenty thousand?

verses.text: If not, while the other is yet a great way off, he will send a delegation to ask for conditions of peace.
verses.html: If not, while the other is yet a great way off, he will send a delegation to ask for conditions of peace.

verses.text: In the same way, then, any of y’all who don’t renounce all that you has cannot be my disciple.
verses.html: In the same way, then, any of y’all who don’t renounce all that you has cannot be my disciple.

verses.text: “Salt is excellent, but if the salt becomes tasteless, with what can it be seasoned?
verses.html: “Salt is excellent, but if the salt becomes tasteless, with what can it be seasoned?

verses.text: It isn’t fit for the soil or for the manure pile. It is thrown out. Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”
verses.html: It isn’t fit for the soil or for the manure pile. It is thrown out. Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Lost Sheep / The Parable of the Lost Sheep
verses.text: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to hear him.
The Pharisees and scribes were complaining, “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”
Then Jesus told them this parable:
“What human among y’all, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the open pasture and go after the lost one until he finds it?
verses.html: “What human among y’all, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the open pasture and go after the lost one until he finds it?

verses.text: When he has found it, he joyfully places it on his shoulders,
verses.html: When he has found it, he joyfully places it on his shoulders,

verses.text: and when he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Y’all rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!’
verses.html: and when he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Y’all rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!’

verses.text: I tell y’all that in the same way, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous people who don’t need repentance.
verses.html: I tell y’all that in the same way, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous people who don’t need repentance.

verses.heading: The Parable of the Lost Coin / The Parable of the Lost Coin
verses.text: “Or what woman, if she had ten silver coins, and lost one of them, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and search carefully until she finds it?
verses.html: “Or what woman, if she had ten silver coins, and lost one of them, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and search carefully until she finds it?

verses.text: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Y’all rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin!’
verses.html: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Y’all rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin!’

verses.text: In the same way, I tell y’all, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.”
verses.html: In the same way, I tell y’all, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Lost Son / The Parable of the Lost Son
verses.text: Then Jesus said, “A certain man had two sons.
verses.html: Then Jesus said, “A certain man had two sons.

verses.text: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me the share of the estate that will come to me.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.
verses.html: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me the share of the estate that will come to me.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

verses.text: Not many days later, the younger son gathered all he had and traveled to a distant country. There he squandered his estate with wild living.
verses.html: Not many days later, the younger son gathered all he had and traveled to a distant country. There he squandered his estate with wild living.

verses.text: When he had spent all of it, a strong famine arose in that country, and he began to be in need.
verses.html: When he had spent all of it, a strong famine arose in that country, and he began to be in need.

verses.text: So he went and hired himself out one of the citizens of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
verses.html: So he went and hired himself out one of the citizens of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

verses.text: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.
verses.html: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.

verses.text: But when he came to his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have bread enough to spare, and I’m here lost with hunger!
verses.html: But when he came to his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have bread enough to spare, and I’m here lost with hunger!

verses.text: I will get up, go to my father, and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.
verses.html: I will get up, go to my father, and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

verses.text: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’
verses.html: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’

verses.text: “So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and felt gut-wrenching sympathy, and ran, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him.
verses.html: “So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and felt gut-wrenching sympathy, and ran, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him.

verses.text: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
verses.html: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

verses.text: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Y’all bring the best robe and put it on him. And y’all put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.
verses.html: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Y’all bring the best robe and put it on him. And y’all put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

verses.text: Y’all bring the fattened calf, kill it. Let’s eat and celebrate!
verses.html: Y’all bring the fattened calf, kill it. Let’s eat and celebrate!

verses.text: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.
verses.html: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

verses.text: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.
verses.html: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.

verses.text: So he summoned one of the servants and asked him what was happening.
verses.html: So he summoned one of the servants and asked him what was happening.

verses.text: ‘Your brother has returned,’ he told him, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’
verses.html: ‘Your brother has returned,’ he told him, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

verses.text: But the older son was enraged and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.
verses.html: But the older son was enraged and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.

verses.text: But he answered his father, ‘Look! All these years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a command of yours. But you never gave me a goat so that I could celebrate with my friends.
verses.html: But he answered his father, ‘Look! All these years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a command of yours. But you never gave me a goat so that I could celebrate with my friends.

verses.text: But when this son of yours, who has devoured your livelihood with prostitutes comes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’
verses.html: But when this son of yours, who has devoured your livelihood with prostitutes comes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’

verses.text: “The father said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.
verses.html: “The father said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

verses.text: But we had to celebrate and rejoice, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’”
verses.html: But we had to celebrate and rejoice, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’”

verses.heading: Parables on Astute Worldly Relationships / Parables on Astute Worldly Relationships
verses.text: Now Jesus said to his disciples, “There was a rich man who received an accusation that his manager was wasting his possessions.
verses.html: Now Jesus said to his disciples, “There was a rich man who received an accusation that his manager was wasting his possessions.

verses.text: So he called him and asked, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, because you can no longer be manager.’
verses.html: So he called him and asked, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, because you can no longer be manager.’

verses.text: “The manager said to himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my master is taking the management away from me? I don’t have the strength to dig, and I’m too ashamed to beg.
verses.html: “The manager said to himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my master is taking the management away from me? I don’t have the strength to dig, and I’m too ashamed to beg.

verses.text: I know what I will do so that when I am removed from management, people will welcome me into their homes.’
verses.html: I know what I will do so that when I am removed from management, people will welcome me into their homes.’

verses.text: So he called each one of his master’s debtors. He said to the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’
verses.html:
So he called each one of his master’s debtors.
He said to the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’

verses.text: He said, ‘A hundred measures of olive oil.’ The manager said to him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and write fifty.’
verses.html:
He said, ‘A hundred measures of olive oil.’
The manager said to him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and write fifty.’

verses.text: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He replied, ‘A hundred measures of wheat.’ The manager said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
verses.html:
Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’
He replied, ‘A hundred measures of wheat.’
The manager said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

verses.text: “His master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the children of this age are more shrewd than the children of the light in dealing with their own people.
verses.html: “His master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the children of this age are more shrewd than the children of the light in dealing with their own people.

verses.text: I am telling y’all, y’all must make friends for yourselves* by using unrighteous wealth so that when it runs out, y’all will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.
verses.html: I am telling y’all, y’all must make friends for yourselves* by using unrighteous wealth so that when it runs out, y’all will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.

verses.text: Whoever is faithful in a very little is also faithful with much. Whoever is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest with much.
verses.html: Whoever is faithful in a very little is also faithful with much. Whoever is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest with much.

verses.text: So if y’all haven’t been faithful with unrighteous wealth, who will trust y’all with true riches?
verses.html: So if y’all haven’t been faithful with unrighteous wealth, who will trust y’all with true riches?

verses.text: And if y’all haven’t been faithful with what belongs to someone else, who will give y’all what is your* own?
verses.html: And if y’all haven’t been faithful with what belongs to someone else, who will give y’all what is your* own?

verses.text: No servant can serve two masters. A person will hate the one and love the other, or be devoted to one and despise the other. Y’all can’t serve both God and wealth.”
verses.html: No servant can serve two masters. A person will hate the one and love the other, or be devoted to one and despise the other. Y’all can’t serve both God and wealth.”

verses.text: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all this and scoffed at him.
Jesus said to them, “Y’all are the ones who justify yourselves* in the sight of humans, but God knows y’all’s hearts. For what is highly esteemed by humans is detestable in the sight of God.
verses.html: Jesus said to them, “Y’all are the ones who justify yourselves* in the sight of humans, but God knows y’all’s hearts. For what is highly esteemed by humans is detestable in the sight of God.

verses.text: “The Law and the Prophets lead up to John. Since then, the gospel of the Empire of God is proclaimed, and everyone is strongly urged to enter it.
verses.html: “The Law and the Prophets lead up to John. Since then, the gospel of the Empire of God is proclaimed, and everyone is strongly urged to enter it.

verses.text: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the Law to drop out.
verses.html: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the Law to drop out.

verses.text: “Anyone who divorces his wife and marries someone else commits adultery. And anyone who marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery.
verses.html: “Anyone who divorces his wife and marries someone else commits adultery. And anyone who marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery.

verses.heading: The Rich Man and Lazarus / The Rich Man and Lazarus
verses.text: “There was a rich man who dressed in purple and fine linen, happily living in luxury every day.
verses.html: “There was a rich man who dressed in purple and fine linen, happily living in luxury every day.

verses.text: A poor man named Lazarus was dropped off at his gate, full of sores.
verses.html: A poor man named Lazarus was dropped off at his gate, full of sores.

verses.text: He longed to be fed with what fell from the rich man’s table, but instead the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.html: He longed to be fed with what fell from the rich man’s table, but instead the dogs came and licked his sores.

verses.text: The poor man died, and he was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried.
verses.html: The poor man died, and he was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried.

verses.text: While he was in torment in Hades, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham far off with Lazarus by his side.
verses.html: While he was in torment in Hades, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham far off with Lazarus by his side.

verses.text: So he called out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me! Send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, for I am in agony in these flames.’
verses.html: So he called out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me! Send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, for I am in agony in these flames.’

verses.text: “But Abraham said, ‘Child, remember that in your lifetime, you received your good things, just as Lazarus received bad things. But now he is comforted here and you are in agony.
verses.html: “But Abraham said, ‘Child, remember that in your lifetime, you received your good things, just as Lazarus received bad things. But now he is comforted here and you are in agony.

verses.text: Besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and y’all, so that those who want to pass from here to y’all are not able, nor can anyone cross over from there to us.’
verses.html: Besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and y’all, so that those who want to pass from here to y’all are not able, nor can anyone cross over from there to us.’

verses.text: “He said, ‘Then I beg you, father, to send Lazarus to my father’s house,
verses.html: “He said, ‘Then I beg you, father, to send Lazarus to my father’s house,

verses.text: for I have five brothers, to warn them, so that they won’t also come to this place of torment.’
verses.html: for I have five brothers, to warn them, so that they won’t also come to this place of torment.’

verses.text: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets. They should listen to them.’
verses.html: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets. They should listen to them.’

verses.text: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.’
verses.html: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.’

verses.text: “But he told him, ‘If they didn’t listen to Moses and the Prophets, they won’t be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”
verses.html: “But he told him, ‘If they didn’t listen to Moses and the Prophets, they won’t be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”

verses.heading: Forgiveness and Faith / Forgiveness and Faith
verses.text: He said to the disciples, “Stumbling blocks will definitely come, but woe to anyone through whom they come!
verses.html: He said to the disciples, “Stumbling blocks will definitely come, but woe to anyone through whom they come!

verses.text: It would be better for them if they were thrown into the sea with millstone hung around their neck than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
verses.html: It would be better for them if they were thrown into the sea with millstone hung around their neck than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.

verses.text: Y’all be careful. If your sibling sins against you, rebuke them. If they repent, forgive them.
verses.html: Y’all be careful. If your sibling sins against you, rebuke them. If they repent, forgive them.

verses.text: If they sin against you seven times in a day and return to you seven times, saying, ‘I repent,’ you are to forgive him.”
verses.html: If they sin against you seven times in a day and return to you seven times, saying, ‘I repent,’ you are to forgive him.”

verses.text: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
The Lord said, “If y’all have faith as small as a mustard seed, y’all could say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey y’all.
verses.html: The Lord said, “If y’all have faith as small as a mustard seed, y’all could say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey y’all.

verses.text: Which of y’all, will say to a servant who comes in from plowing or shepherding sheep, ‘Come immediately and sit down to eat’?
verses.html: Which of y’all, will say to a servant who comes in from plowing or shepherding sheep, ‘Come immediately and sit down to eat’?

verses.text: Instead, wouldn’t the master say to him, ‘Prepare my dinner, get yourself ready, and serve me while I eat and drink. After that, you may eat and drink’?
verses.html: Instead, wouldn’t the master say to him, ‘Prepare my dinner, get yourself ready, and serve me while I eat and drink. After that, you may eat and drink’?

verses.text: Will he thank the servant because he did the things that were commanded?
verses.html: Will he thank the servant because he did the things that were commanded?

verses.text: In the same way, when y’all have done all the things that are commanded, y’all should say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have only done our duty.’”
verses.html: In the same way, when y’all have done all the things that are commanded, y’all should say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have only done our duty.’”

verses.heading: Ten Men Healed, One Man Gives Thanks / Ten Men Healed, One Man Gives Thanks
verses.text: While on the way to Jerusalem, Jesus passed through the border between Samaria and Galilee.
As he entered into a village, ten men with leprosy met him. They stood at a distance
and raised their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
When he saw them, he said to them, “Y’all go and show yourselves to the priests.” And while they were going, they were cleansed.
verses.html: When he saw them, he said to them, “Y’all go and show yourselves to the priests.” And while they were going, they were cleansed.

verses.text: But one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back and glorified God with a loud voice.
He fell on his face at Jesus’s feet, thanking him—and he was a Samaritan.
Jesus answered, “Weren’t there ten who were cleansed? Where are the other nine?
verses.html: Jesus answered, “Weren’t there ten who were cleansed? Where are the other nine?

verses.text: Was anyone else found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”
verses.html: Was anyone else found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

verses.text: Then he said to him, “Arise and go. Your faith has saved you.”
verses.html: Then he said to him, “Arise and go. Your faith has saved you.”

verses.heading: The Empire of God Is Near / The Empire of God Is Near
verses.text: The Pharisees questioned him about when the Empire of God would come, and Jesus answered them, “The Empire of God does not come with something observable,
verses.html: The Pharisees questioned him about when the Empire of God would come, and Jesus answered them, “The Empire of God does not come with something observable,

verses.text: nor will anyone say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘There it is!’ for indeed, the Empire of God is in y’all’s midst.”
verses.html: nor will anyone say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘There it is!’ for indeed, the Empire of God is in y’all’s midst.”

verses.text: Then he said to the disciples, “The days are coming when y’all will long to see one of the days of the Son of Humanity, but y’all won’t see it.
verses.html: Then he said to the disciples, “The days are coming when y’all will long to see one of the days of the Son of Humanity, but y’all won’t see it.

verses.text: People will tell y’all, ‘Look here! Look there!’ But y’all must not go out and run after them.
verses.html: People will tell y’all, ‘Look here! Look there!’ But y’all must not go out and run after them.

verses.text: For as lightning flashes from one end of the sky and lights up the other side, so will the Son of Humanity be in his day.
verses.html: For as lightning flashes from one end of the sky and lights up the other side, so will the Son of Humanity be in his day.

verses.text: But first it is necessary that he suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
verses.html: But first it is necessary that he suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

verses.text: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so it will be in the days of the Son of Humanity.
verses.html: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so it will be in the days of the Son of Humanity.

verses.text: People were eating and drinking, getting married and being given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
verses.html: People were eating and drinking, getting married and being given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

verses.text: Likewise, it will be as it was in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
verses.html: Likewise, it will be as it was in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.

verses.text: But on the day that Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained from the sky and destroyed them all.
verses.html: But on the day that Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained from the sky and destroyed them all.

verses.text: It will just like this on the day that the Son of Humanity is revealed.
verses.html: It will just like this on the day that the Son of Humanity is revealed.

verses.text: On that day, anyone who is on the roof and has possessions inside the house, must not go down to get them. Likewise anyone in the field likewise not turn back.
verses.html: On that day, anyone who is on the roof and has possessions inside the house, must not go down to get them. Likewise anyone in the field likewise not turn back.

verses.text: Y’all must remember Lot’s wife!
verses.html: Y’all must remember Lot’s wife!

verses.text: Whoever tries to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life will preserve it.
verses.html: Whoever tries to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life will preserve it.

verses.text: I tell y’all, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other will be left.
verses.html: I tell y’all, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other will be left.

verses.text: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other will be left.”
verses.html: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other will be left.”

verses.text: Then they asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the dead body is, there the vultures will gather.”
verses.html:
Then they asked him, “Where, Lord?”
He said to them, “Where the dead body is, there the vultures will gather.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Persistent Widow / The Parable of the Persistent Widow
verses.text: Then Jesus told them a parable about the need to always pray and not give up.
He said, “In a certain town, there was a judge who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect humans.
verses.html: He said, “In a certain town, there was a judge who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect humans.

verses.text: There was a widow in that town, who kept coming to him and saying, ‘Give me justice against my adversary!’
verses.html: There was a widow in that town, who kept coming to him and saying, ‘Give me justice against my adversary!’

verses.text: For a time, he refused. But after a while, he said to himself, ‘Even though I don’t fear God or respect humans,
verses.html: For a time, he refused. But after a while, he said to himself, ‘Even though I don’t fear God or respect humans,

verses.text: yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will give her justice, so that in the end she won’t beat me down by her persistent coming.’”
verses.html: yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will give her justice, so that in the end she won’t beat me down by her persistent coming.’”

verses.text: Then the Lord said, “Y’all listen to what the unjust judge says.
verses.html: Then the Lord said, “Y’all listen to what the unjust judge says.

verses.text: Won’t God bring justice to ʜɪꜱ chosen ones who are crying out to ʜɪᴍ day and night? Will ʜᴇ delay helping them?
verses.html: Won’t God bring justice to ʜɪꜱ chosen ones who are crying out to ʜɪᴍ day and night? Will ʜᴇ delay helping them?

verses.text: I tell y’all that ʜᴇ bring justice to them quickly. However, when the Son of Humanity comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
verses.html: I tell y’all that ʜᴇ bring justice to them quickly. However, when the Son of Humanity comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Pharisee and the Tax Collector / The Parable of the Pharisee and the Tax Collector
verses.text: Jesus also told this parable to people who were convinced of their own righteousness and despised everyone else:
“Two men went up into the temple to pray, one was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
verses.html: “Two men went up into the temple to pray, one was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

verses.text: The Pharisee stood and prayed about himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other humans: extortionists, law breakers, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
verses.html: The Pharisee stood and prayed about himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other humans: extortionists, law breakers, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

verses.text: I fast twice a week, and I give a tenth of all that I get.’
verses.html: I fast twice a week, and I give a tenth of all that I get.’

verses.text: But the tax collector stood far away and wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven. Instead, he beat his chest, saying, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner!’
verses.html: But the tax collector stood far away and wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven. Instead, he beat his chest, saying, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner!’

verses.text: I tell y’all, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other. For everyone who exalts themself will be humbled, but the one who humbles themself will be exalted.”
verses.html: I tell y’all, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other. For everyone who exalts themself will be humbled, but the one who humbles themself will be exalted.”

verses.heading: Jesus Welcomes the Little Children / Jesus Welcomes the Little Children
verses.text: People were also bringing their babies to Jesus so that he would touch them. But when the disciples saw this, they chided them.
But Jesus invited the children, saying, “Y’all must let the little children to come to me, and y’all must not stop them, for the Empire of God belongs to such as these.
verses.html: But Jesus invited the children, saying, “Y’all must let the little children to come to me, and y’all must not stop them, for the Empire of God belongs to such as these.

verses.text: Truly, I tell y’all, whoever doesn’t receive the Empire of God like a little child will never enter into it.”
verses.html: Truly, I tell y’all, whoever doesn’t receive the Empire of God like a little child will never enter into it.”

verses.heading: The Peril of Wealth for the Empire / The Peril of Wealth for the Empire
verses.text: A certain ruler questioned him, saying, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
Jesus responded to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one, God.
verses.html: Jesus responded to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one, God.

verses.text: You know the commandments: ‘You must not commit adultery,’ ‘You must not murder,’ ‘You must not steal,’ ‘You must not give false testimony,’ ‘You must honor your father and your mother.’”
verses.html: You know the commandments: ‘You must not commit adultery,’ ‘You must not murder,’ ‘You must not steal,’ ‘You must not give false testimony,’ ‘You must honor your father and your mother.’”

verses.text: He said, “I have kept all of these since my youth.”
When Jesus heard this, he said to him, “Still you lack one thing. Sell everything you have and distribute it to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then you come, follow me.”
verses.html: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, “Still you lack one thing. Sell everything you have and distribute it to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then you come, follow me.”

verses.text: But when he heard this, he became very sad, for he was extremely wealthy.
Jesus looked at him and said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the Empire of God!
verses.html: Jesus looked at him and said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the Empire of God!

verses.text: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the Empire of God.”
verses.html: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the Empire of God.”

verses.text: Those who heard this said, “Then who can be saved?”
But Jesus replied, “What is impossible for humans is possible with God.”
verses.html: But Jesus replied, “What is impossible for humans is possible with God.”

verses.text: Then Peter said, “Look, we left everything we had and followed you.”
So he said to them, “Truly I tell y’all, there is no one who has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the Empire of God,
verses.html: So he said to them, “Truly I tell y’all, there is no one who has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the Empire of God,

verses.text: who will not receive many times more in this age, and eternal life in the age to come.”
verses.html: who will not receive many times more in this age, and eternal life in the age to come.”

verses.heading: Jesus Again Foretells His Death / Jesus Again Foretells His Death
verses.text: Then he took the twelve aside and said to them, “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written in the prophets about the Son of Humanity will come to completion.
verses.html: Then he took the twelve aside and said to them, “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written in the prophets about the Son of Humanity will come to completion.

verses.text: For he will be delivered up to the ethnic groups, and will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
verses.html: For he will be delivered up to the ethnic groups, and will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

verses.text: They will flog him and kill him. And on the third day, he will rise again.”
verses.html: They will flog him and kill him. And on the third day, he will rise again.”

verses.text: But they understood none of these things. This meaning of this statement was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand what he was saying.

verses.heading: A Blind Beggar Receives His Sight / A Blind Beggar Receives His Sight
verses.text: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the road begging.
When he heard the crowd passing by, he asked what was happening.
They told him, “Jesus the Nazarene is coming through.”
Then he cried out, “Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me!”
Those who led the way sternly told him to be silent. But he shouted all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
So Jesus stopped and ordered that the man be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,
“What do you want me to do for you?” He said, “Lord, I want to see again.”
verses.html:
“What do you want me to do for you?”
He said, “Lord, I want to see again.”

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has saved you.”
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has saved you.”

verses.text: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. And when all the people saw this, they praised God.

verses.heading: Zacchaeus the Tax Collector / Zacchaeus the Tax Collector
verses.text: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through it.
There was a man named Zacchaeus who was a chief tax collector, and he was wealthy.
He was trying to see who Jesus was, but couldn’t because of the crowd, since he was a short man.
He ran ahead and climbed up a sycamore tree to see Jesus, since he was about to pass that way.
When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today it is necessary for me to stay at your house.”
verses.html: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today it is necessary for me to stay at your house.”

verses.text: He hurried, came down, and welcomed him joyfully.
When the people saw this, they all began to complain, “He has gone in to be the guest of a man who is a sinner.”
Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Look, I will give half of my possessions to the poor, Lord! And if I have cheated anyone out of anything, I will pay back four times as much.”
Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he too is a son of Abraham.
verses.html: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he too is a son of Abraham.

verses.text: For the Son of Humanity has come to seek and save the lost.”
verses.html: For the Son of Humanity has come to seek and save the lost.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Ten Minas / The Parable of the Ten Minas
verses.text: While the people were listening to these things, Jesus proceeded to tell a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they thought the Empire of God would be revealed immediately.
Therefore he said, “A man of noble birth went into a far country to receive an empire for himself and then to return.
verses.html: Therefore he said, “A man of noble birth went into a far country to receive an empire for himself and then to return.

verses.text: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Y’all are to do business with this until I come back.’
verses.html: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Y’all are to do business with this until I come back.’

verses.text: But his subjects hated him, and sent an envoy after him to say, ‘We don’t want this man to be king over us.’
verses.html: But his subjects hated him, and sent an envoy after him to say, ‘We don’t want this man to be king over us.’

verses.text: “When he received the empire and returned, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained in business.
verses.html: “When he received the empire and returned, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained in business.

verses.text: The first came forward and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned ten more minas.’
verses.html: The first came forward and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned ten more minas.’

verses.text: “The king said to him, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful with very little, you will have authority over ten cities.’
verses.html: “The king said to him, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful with very little, you will have authority over ten cities.’

verses.text: “The second came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has made five minas.’
verses.html: “The second came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has made five minas.’

verses.text: “So the king said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
verses.html: “So the king said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

verses.text: Then another came and said, ‘Sir, look, here is your mina which I kept safe in a handkerchief,
verses.html: Then another came and said, ‘Sir, look, here is your mina which I kept safe in a handkerchief,

verses.text: because I was afraid you, since you are an exacting man. You withdraw what you didn’t deposit, and reap what you didn’t sow.’
verses.html: because I was afraid you, since you are an exacting man. You withdraw what you didn’t deposit, and reap what you didn’t sow.’

verses.text: “The king said to him, ‘I will judge you by the words from your own mouth, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, withdrawing what I didn’t deposit and reaping that which I didn’t sow.
verses.html: “The king said to him, ‘I will judge you by the words from your own mouth, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, withdrawing what I didn’t deposit and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

verses.text: Then why didn’t you put my money in the bank, so that when I returned, I might could have collected it with interest?’
verses.html: Then why didn’t you put my money in the bank, so that when I returned, I might could have collected it with interest?’

verses.text: Then he said to those standing nearby, ‘Y’all take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
verses.html: Then he said to those standing nearby, ‘Y’all take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

verses.text: “They said to him, ‘Sir, he has ten minas!’

verses.text: ‘For I tell y’all that to everyone who has, more will be given, but from those who do not have, even what they have will be taken away.

verses.html: But those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to be king over them—y’all bring them and kill them in front of me.’”

verses.heading: The Humble King Enters His City / The Humble King Enters His City
verses.text: After he said these things, Jesus went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
When he came near to Bethphage and Bethany, at the placed called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of the disciples,
saying, “Y’all go to the village ahead of you. Near the entrance, y’all will find a colt tied, which no human has ever sat upon. Untie it and y’all bring it here.
verses.html: saying, “Y’all go to the village ahead of you. Near the entrance, y’all will find a colt tied, which no human has ever sat upon. Untie it and y’all bring it here.

verses.text: If anyone asks y’all, ‘Why are y’all untying it?’ say this: ‘The Lord needs it.’”
verses.html: If anyone asks y’all, ‘Why are y’all untying it?’ say this: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

verses.text: Those who were sent ahead went and found things just as he had told them.
As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are y’all untying the colt?”
They said, “The Lord needs it.”
Then they brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt, and had Jesus get on it.
As he was going along, they spread their garments on the road.
As he approached the path down to the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen,
“Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord [YHWH]! Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”
Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
He answered, “I am telling y’all, if they keep silent, the stones will cry out.”
verses.html: He answered, “I am telling y’all, if they keep silent, the stones will cry out.”

verses.text: As he approached Jerusalem, he saw the city and wept over it,
saying, “If you, even you, had known on this day the things which would bring your peace! But now, they have been hidden from your eyes.
verses.html: saying, “If you, even you, had known on this day the things which would bring your peace! But now, they have been hidden from your eyes.

verses.text: For the days will come on you when your enemies will build a barricade around you, surround you, and close in on you in from every side.
verses.html: For the days will come on you when your enemies will build a barricade around you, surround you, and close in on you in from every side.

verses.text: They will throw you and your children to the ground, and they will not leave one stone on another within your borders, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation.”
verses.html: They will throw you and your children to the ground, and they will not leave one stone on another within your borders, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation.”

verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses His Temple / Jesus Cleanses His Temple
verses.text: When Jesus entered the temple, he began to drive out those who were selling,
saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house will be a house of prayer,’ but y’all have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
verses.html: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house will be a house of prayer,’ but y’all have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

verses.text: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leaders of the people were trying to destroy him.
They couldn’t find a way to do it, because all the people were hanging on him, listening.

verses.heading: Jesus Questions His Questioners / Jesus Questions His Questioners
verses.text: One day while Jesus was teaching the people in the temple and proclaiming the good news, the chief priests, and elders came to him
and asked, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Who is it who gave you this authority?”
But he answered them, “I also will ask y’all a question. Y’all tell me:
verses.html: But he answered them, “I also will ask y’all a question. Y’all tell me:

verses.text: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of human origin?”
verses.html: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of human origin?”

verses.text: They discussed among themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t y’all believe him?’
But if we say, ‘Of human origin,’ all the people will stone us, because they are convinced that John was a prophet.”
So they answered that they didn’t know its origin.
Then Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell y’all by what authority I do these things.”
verses.html: Then Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell y’all by what authority I do these things.”

verses.heading: The Parable of the Tenants / The Parable of the Tenants
verses.text: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some tenant farmers, and travelled abroad for a long time.
verses.html: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some tenant farmers, and travelled abroad for a long time.

verses.text: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the farmers to some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.html: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the farmers to some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.text: He sent another servant, and they also beat him, treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.html: He sent another servant, and they also beat him, treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.text: He sent yet a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.
verses.html: He sent yet a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.

verses.text: The owner of the vineyard said, ‘What should I do? I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.’
verses.html: The owner of the vineyard said, ‘What should I do? I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.’

verses.text: “But when the farmers saw him, they deliberated among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Let’s kill him, so that the inheritance may be ours.’
verses.html: “But when the farmers saw him, they deliberated among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Let’s kill him, so that the inheritance may be ours.’

So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
“What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

verses.text: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When the people heard this, they said, “May that never be!”
verses.html: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When the people heard this, they said, “May that never be!”

verses.text: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of what is written, ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone?’

verses.text: The scribes and chief priests wanted to arrest him that very hour, because they knew he had spoken this parable against them. But they feared the people.

verses.heading: An Attempt to Trap Jesus on Taxes / An Attempt to Trap Jesus on Taxes
verses.text: Then they watched him closely and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, so that they could trap him in something he said and deliver him up to the governor’s jurisdiction and authority.
They questioned him, “Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and you don’t show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.
Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
But Jesus picked up on their trickery, and said to them,
“Y’all show me a denarius. Whose image and title are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”
verses.html:
“Y’all show me a denarius. Whose image and title are on it?”
They answered, “Caesar’s.”

verses.text: He said to them, “Well then y’all should give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
verses.html: He said to them, “Well then y’all should give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

verses.text: They weren’t able to trap him in his words in public. They marveled at his answer and became silent.

verses.heading: Questions about Resurrection / Questions about Resurrection
verses.text: Some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is a resurrection, came and questioned him,
saying, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies with a wife but no children, his brother should marry the wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
Now there were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
Also the second
and the third took her, and likewise all seven died, leaving no children.
Finally the woman also died.
In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to he?.”
Jesus replied, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.
verses.html: Jesus replied, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

verses.text: But those who are considered worthy to take part in that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
verses.html: But those who are considered worthy to take part in that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

verses.text: For they are no longer able to die, because they are like the angels. They are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
verses.html: For they are no longer able to die, because they are like the angels. They are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

verses.text: But even Moses showed that the dead are raised in the passage about burning bush where he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
verses.html: But even Moses showed that the dead are raised in the passage about burning bush where he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

verses.text: Hᴇ is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
verses.html: Hᴇ is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

For they didn’t dare ask him anything else.
Then he said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is the son of David?
verses.html: Then he said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is the son of David?

verses.html:
David himself says in the book of Psalms,

“Y’all must beware of the scribes who like to walk in flowing robes, and who love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
verses.html: “Y’all must beware of the scribes who like to walk in flowing robes, and who love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.

verses.html: They devour widows’ houses and offer long prayers for show. These will receive greater condemnation.”

verses.heading: The Widow’s Offering / The Widow’s Offering
verses.text: Jesus looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the temple treasury.
He saw a poor widow casting in two small copper coins.
He said, “Truly I tell y’all, this poor widow put in more than all of them.
verses.html: He said, “Truly I tell y’all, this poor widow put in more than all of them.

verses.text: They all put in gifts from their wealth, but she, out of her poverty, has put in all that she had to live on.”
verses.html: They all put in gifts from their wealth, but she, out of her poverty, has put in all that she had to live on.”

verses.text: While some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
“As for these things which y’all are looking at, the days will come when not one stone will be left on another that will not be thrown down.”
verses.html: “As for these things which y’all are looking at, the days will come when not one stone will be left on another that will not be thrown down.”

verses.html: He said, “Y’all watch out that you* don’t get led astray. For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Y’all must not follow them.

verses.html: When y’all hear of wars and disturbances, y’all shouldn’t be frightened. Indeed, it is necessary for things to happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

verses.html: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on y’all and will persecute y’all, delivering y’all up to synagogues and prisons, bringing y’all before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

verses.text: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the what is called the Mount of Olives.
All the people came early in the morning to hear him in the temple.

verses.heading: Judas Plans to Betray Jesus / Judas Plans to Betray Jesus
verses.text: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching.
The chief priests and the scribes were seeking a way to eliminate Jesus, because they were afraid of the people.
Then Satan entered into Judas, called Iscariot, who was numbered among the twelve.
Judas went away and talked with the chief priests and officers of temple guard about how he might deliver Jesus to them.
They were delighted and agreed to give him silver.
He acknowledged and began looking for an opportunity to deliver Jesus to them when there were no crowds.

verses.heading: The Last Supper / The Last Supper
verses.text: The day of Unleavened Bread came when the Passover lamb must be sacrificed.
Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Y’all Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”
verses.html: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Y’all Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”

verses.text: They asked him, “Where do you want us to prepare for it?”
He said to them, “As y’all enter the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet y’all. Y’all follow him into the house that he enters,
verses.html: He said to them, “As y’all enter the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet y’all. Y’all follow him into the house that he enters,

He said to them, “I have desiringly-desired to eat this Passover with y’all before I suffer.

verses.html: For I tell y’all, I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the Empire of God.”

verses.html: For I tell y’all, I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until the Empire of God comes.”

verses.html: He took bread, and after giving thanks, he broke it and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for y’all. Y’all do this in remembrance of me.”
